In our road detection system, we reduce the forward time when the detection accuracy is close to other state-of-the-art algorithms. These benefits from the faster forward network we use and the Multi Detection Model we designed. Modern deep convolutional network architecture becomes wider and deeper because they can improve network performance. According to this idea, we proposed a Multi Detection Model (MDM) for applying in our road detection system. With the input of high resolution (375×1242), our network is trained end-to-end. Compared with the other state-of-the-art networks in the KITTI road detection, we shortened the calculation time when the detection accuracy was close to.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Fuzzy Energy Management and Braking Strategy of Parallel Hybrid Vehicle
abstract: In this paper, a hierarchical fuzzy strategy wa s proposed in order to minimize total energy consumption. Based on the data transfer between the various parts of the engine, drive motor, battery and other parts of the mathematical model and the vehicle in ADVISOR established a simulation model of each part. Meanwhile, to enhance the efficiency of energy recovery, a braking strategy was presented. The proposed strategy is performed using MATLAB/ADVISOR on several driving cycles. Compared with other controller, this method could minimize fuel consumption and enhance the efficiency of energy recovery approximately.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Bat Algorithm for Multi-objective Optimal Power Flow Problem
abstract: To handle multi-objective optimal power flow (MOO PF) pro blem while satisfying various system constraints, a new multi-objective improved bat algorithm (MOIBA) is proposed. MOIBA algorithm can improve the shortcoming of basic bat algorithm which has weak global exploration and unsatisfactory diversity. To validate the performance of MOmA algorithm, IEEE30 bus system is implemented on MATLAB software to optimize, respectively, power loss and fuel cost concurrently, emission and fuel cost concurrently, power loss and emission concurrently. A Pareto-dominant Method with constraint (PDM) is employed to satisfy inequa Ii ty constraints of state variables. The results obtained by MOIBA algorithm, compared with MOPSO algorithm, show the effectiveness and superiority of proposed MOrnA algorithm in solving MOOPF problem.

articleTitle: Graph Comparison and Coupling Strength Allocation for Synchronization in Multiplex Networks
abstract: This paper is aimed at exploring the strength allocation strategy on multiplex network from the perspective of graph theory. Assuming the topology and the sum of strength are fixed, distributing couplings strength with different numerical value to enhance synchronizability. Compared with average distribution and degree distribution, allocation referred to graph comparison method is more comprehensive and high-performance. Numerical examples for physical multiplex network are also provided to confirm the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research and design of environmental monitoring and road lighting system based on the Internet of things
abstract: In view of the problems of low efficiency, single lighting mode and poor expansibility in urban road lighting system, an environment monitoring and road lighting system based on the IoT(Internet of Things) technology is proposed by this paper. The system incorporates urban road lighting and environmental monitoring into the new urban Internet of Things system, and combines GPRS/NB-IoT network with LORA network. Through the integrated use of embedded technologies, wireless sensor networks and other technologies, we can achieve intelligent, digital city road lighting control and provide environmental monitoring capabilities. This system will become a platform for the delivery of smart cities, and it will be able to scientifically and efficiently improve the intelligent management and services of environmental monitoring and road lighting.

articleTitle: Real-Time Analysis and Study on Messages on In-Vehicle CAN Gateway
abstract: The transmission delay of CAN gateway message will affect the real-time performance of the whole CAN network. Firstly, the transmission delay model of CAN gateway message is analyzed in this paper. After two algorithms, ID Priority Scheduling (IDPS) algorithm and Earliest Deadline First (EDF) algorithm, are compared, the Dynamic Feedback based Hybrid Priority Scheduling (DFHPS)algorithm is proposed with implementation algorithm. Finally, Hardware In Loop (HIL) simulation test is conducted. The test results show that this method can effectively reduce the delay of high-priority messages when the network load rate is high, and ensure that low-priority messages can also get good response time.

articleTitle: Extending the Dynamic Stixel World with B-Spline based Road Estimation for Obstacle Detection
abstract: Stixel based obstacle detection plays an important role in obstacle detection yet with the limitation of assuming a flat road. This assumption would mistake a sloping road in front of the flat one as obstacle. In this paper, we extend the dynamic stixel world with the cubic B-spline based non-flat road estimation in the v-disparity map. The parameters of B-spline are tracked over time using a Kalman filter. We also add color histogram to the stixel for a better representing. Experimental results in KITTI benchmark show the stixel building efficiency of our method in distinguishing between an uprising road and obstacles. Meanwhile, our method achieves an average 3.2% accuracy gain for obstacle detection, and can realize real-time performance about 72 ms per frame on our local computer containing an Intel is-7500T CPU with 2.7 GHz frequency and GTX 1080Ti GPU used for stereo matching.

articleTitle: Finite-time Anti-synchronization of Stochastic Delayed Memristive Neural Networks
abstract: In this paper, the finite time anti-synchronization of stochastic memristive neural network has been investigated under the framework of Filippov sense. To obtain the anti-synchronization, firstly, we discussed both continuous and discontinuous control, respectively. Then, the new switching controller is presented considering the characteristic of continuous and discontinuous controllers. Correspondingly, some useful results are established, meanwhile, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of obtained results.

articleTitle: A feedforward method based on support vector machine
abstract: The optimal estimation of the target movement state is the key technology of target tracking. The single-model predictive filtering algorithm cannot satisfy the requirement of accuracy when the system is tracking a strong maneuver target. Because the estimation algorithm is inaccurate when the target's motion state and model do not match. The multi-model algorithm is proposed to solve this problem and it does effectively improve the estimation accuracy. However, it is hard to apply to the actual engineering due to the large calculation quantity. In this paper, a feedforward method based on SVM is proposed. This method uses SVM to classify the target's motion state and gets the most suitable motion model to the targets current state. This model is utilized to predict and estimate the motion parameters of the target in the way of single model. Therefore, the contradiction between calculation quantity and precision is alleviated. Then, the target motion parameters are fed into the system, and the target is tracked with high precision.

articleTitle: Traffic Police Pose Estimation Based on Multi-branch Network
abstract: To precisely recognizing traffic police gesture, a two-branch multi-stage convolutional neural network (CNN) and an BP neural network (BPNN) classifier has been adopted to achieve the task of traffic police pose estimation in this paper. We simultaneously detect the human joints and associate body parts. When the detection work is done, a BPNN cascades after CNN and serve as a classifier. The experiment results show that traffic police-men's gestures are well recognized by this method.

articleTitle: Development and Industrial Application of a Soft Sensor using Markov Random Fields
abstract: Accurate, real-time access to key performance indicators (KPIs) is critical to the overall performance of industrial processes. However, in many cases, it is difficult to obtain accurate and timely measurements, due to time delays or external disturbances in industrial processes. Soft sensors are one solution that can provide the necessary process information. This paper proposes a new approach for soft sensor design using Markov random fields (MRF). In which, a Gaussian mixture model (GMM) is firstly used to approximate the joint probability distribution in the soft sensor model, then the expectation maximization (EM) algorithm estimates the GMM parameters. Using this approach, a soft sensor is developed using industrial data for the alumina concentration process in the aluminum electrolysis industry, to show our proposed approach provides accurate estimation of the alumina concentration.

articleTitle: Multi-Label Automatic Labeling for Question Attributes Based on Adaboost and Bayes Algorithms
abstract: The attributes, such as knowledge points and difficulty, are important parts of questions. It is related to the automatic classification, auto-generating test paper and adaptive learning. The traditional labeling, however, is done by domain experts and teachers with low efficiency which make it difficult to achieve large-scale automatic labeling. Automatic labeling not only saves a lot of manual labeling costs, but also executes question labeling in batches. Question labeling is an essential text multi-label classification problem. In this paper, we propose an improved multi-label classification algorithm based on naive Bayes algorithm, combined with AdaBoost algorithm. We develop a new evaluation model of classification precision for the hierarchical characteristic of question knowledge point structure. The experimental results demonstrate the proposed algorithm outperforms to the naive Bayes algorithm and the SVM algorithm in precision, recall and Fl- value.

articleTitle: Balance Mechanism Design for the Fusion of Pure Pursuit and PI Tracking Controller
abstract: Making use of the PID controller to make up the defeat of the geometric controller like Pure Pursuit is a very effective way to improve the effects of the Pure Pursuit (PP). However, existed methods didn't explain the internal principle of the fusion. This paper will try to give a detailed analysis about the fusion mechanism. Firstly, we will discuss the error caused by PP, and then we will separately analyze how the PI controller correct the error. Based on the above discussion, we conclude that the weight parameters are very important to the performance of the fusion controller. Thereby, we proposed a Genetic Algorithm (GA) based parameter tuning method to improve the accuracy of the fusion method. Finally, the experiments on CARLA simulator prove the effects of GA based PP_PI (PP fusion with PI) method in urban driving scenario.

articleTitle: The Impedance-Based Stability Analysis of the Single-Phase Solid State Transformer
abstract: The whole stability analysis of the single-phase solid state transformer (SST) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the different SST concepts has been researched in literature and technical aspects. Meanwhile, plenty of inherent characteristics can potentially limit the application of the SST in microgrid, e.g. low-frequency oscillation and harmonic oscillation. As a result, the stability analysis of the SST in detail is discussed in this paper. First and foremost, the typical structure of the SST and its each subsystem controller are studied. Further, the stability analysis of the each subsystem is provided via closed-loop transfer function, respectively. In the end, the whole stability analysis based on Z+Z type cascade system impedance analysis is studied. The impedance-based stability analysis method of the single-phase SST can be validated through relative simulation results.

articleTitle: Sliding-mode-control-based Differential Geometric Guidance Law using Mild Sliding Manifolds
abstract: Based on sliding mode control, this paper presents a novel differential geometric guidance law for a homing missile against maneuvering targets. The three-dimensional guidance problem is reduced to two-dimensions by an engagement plane rotation reference frame. In the design of guidance law, two well-constructed mild sliding manifolds are introduced to decrease control efforts. Moreover, target maneuver is treated as a disturbance with known upper bound and no algorithm is required to estimate the maneuver. Simulation results illustrate that the mild sliding manifolds can be fast arrived at in finite time and the proposed differential geometric guidance law yields better performance by contrast with other existing guidance laws.

articleTitle: Method of Networked Knowledge Integration and Knowledge Push for Railway Signal Maintenance
abstract: In order to improve the intelligence and efficiency of railway signal maintenance, a method of knowledge integration and push for networked maintenance process was proposed. Firstly, the knowledge involved in maintenance service process was analyzed, and a method of knowledge integration model of networked maintenance process based on knowledge service process was built. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of railway signal maintenance knowledge, this paper proposes an ontology-based knowledge push mechanism through the description of maintenance knowledge scenarios in different dimensions. Finally, through the application of active push of equipment maintenance knowledge in a railway signal department, this method was proved to be effective in active maintenance knowledge push.

articleTitle: Application of NB-IoT Technology in Internet of Things Label Printer
abstract: Numbers of technological innovations take place in traditional industries because of the development of Internet of Things (IoT). In order to guarantee the quality of radio frequency identification (RFID) label printer supplies and increase sales of printer supplies, the narrowband IoT (NB-IoT) technology is applied to RFID label printer to implement printer access to the Internet. Based on information technologies, such as Internet of Things and cloud computing, the printer becomes more intelligent. Information of printer supplies is uploaded to cloud verification platform to carry out anti-counterfeiting certification. Printer companies can collect usage of supplies of customers for data analysis through NB-loT technology. And printer companies can also inform users of shortages of supplies and supplementing supplies by SMS alerts to expand company's sales. NB-IoT technology helps printer manufacturers to achieve remote fault analyzing and help customers to solve problems of printer.

articleTitle: Distributed parallel machines scheduling in the heterogeneous production network: a variable neighborhood search
abstract: Distributed parallel machines scheduling problems (DPMSP) are not investigated fully. In this study DPMSP is studied in the heterogeneous production network, the goal of which is to minimize makespan. An effective variable neighborhood search (VNS) is proposed, in which the coupled relations among sub-problems are used. Only factory assignment is optimized by VNS and other sub-problems are solved by heuristic. A new way is used to compute the initial number of jobs in each factory and a simple coding method is applied to describe factory assignment. Two effective neighborhood structures are presented to generate new solutions of factory assignment. Extensive experiments are conducted to test the performance of VNS and computational results show that VNS is an effective and efficient method for DPMSP.

articleTitle: Soft-Sensor Model of Gas Concentration Based on WOA-ESN Network
abstract: Aiming at gas concentration with characteristics of nonlinearity and time-varying, we propose a soft-sensor model based on WOA-ESN network. The traditional echo state network (ESN) has good performance in the prediction of nonlinear chaotic system, but it's easy to produce pathological solution in the process of output weight. Whale optimization algorithm(WOA) has the characteristics of high search precision and strong search ability, so we adopt it to optimize the output weight of ESN to solve the problem of pathological solution. Thus, the model of prediction accuracy is improved and the dynamic characteristics of ESN are maintained. Through the simulation and verification of the real-measured mine historical gas concentration, comparing with traditional ESN and PSO-ESN models, our proposed soft-sensor model is more accurate in precision, and its feasibility and validity of the soft-sensor model are proved.

articleTitle: Classification and Forecasting for Enterprise Data
abstract: There is an increasing interest in classification and forecasting for enterprise data. Besides many similarity or dissimilarity measures, Support Vector Machines have also been used for time series classification. We classify the industry data with autocorrelation function-distance, an automatic adaptive dissimilarity index and Support Vector Machines respectively. Then we make forecasting for different class. Every class is fitted with particular season model according to Akaike Information Criteria. The orders of the particular model are estimated. A comparative study is presented. It is proposed that an automatic adaptive dissimilarity index outperforms autocorrelation function distance and Support Vector Machines.

articleTitle: An Optimal Control Method of Long Tunnel Ventilation Based on Variable Domain Fuzzy Control
abstract: In order to make a comfortable and safe driving environment for passers in the tunnel, designers need to reduce CO pollutants and visibility indicators to an appropriate level. Road tunnel ventilation is an uncertainty and large time delay system, and it's very difficult to obtain an exact mathematical model. In addition, the traditional fuzzy control (FLC) method is often unable to reduce the concentration of pollutants effectively, which also caused unnecessary waste of ventilation fans. In order to solve the above problems, an optimized fuzzy control is proposed in the article. The FLC was optimally redesigned using the particle swarm algorithm, which is stochastic global search method. This control method is realized by establish the mathematical model of tunnel air volume and analysis the performance indicators in the tunnel. In this way, the fuzzy controller input and the output field are dynamically adjusted to improve the tunnel environment parameters. The simulation and experiment for this new fuzzy control law to be applied in road tunnel ventilation system are conducted. The simulation and experiment showed that the improved method is better and it also cost less energy compared to the traditional fuzzy control method. What's more, this new method is more suitable for fast response of signal transmission in the road tunnel.

articleTitle: Region Based Ensemble Learning Network for Fine-Grained Classification
abstract: As an important research topic in computer vision, fine-grained classification which aims to recognition subordinate-level categories has attracted significant attention. We propose a novel region based ensemble learning network for fine-grained classification. Our approach contains a detection module and a module for classification. The detection module is based on the faster R-CNN framework to locate semantic regions of the object. The classification module using an ensemble learning method, trains a set of sub-classifiers for different semantic regions and combines them together to get a stronger classifier. In the evaluation, we implement experiments on the CUB-2011 dataset and the result of experiments proves our method is efficient for fine-grained classification. We also extend our approach to remote scene recognition and evaluate it on the NWPU-RESISC45 dataset.

articleTitle: H∞Output Tracking Control for Networked Control Systems with Long Time Delays
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of H∞ output tracking control for networked control systems (NeSs) with network-induced long time delays. First, by combining the controlled plant and the reference model, the augmented closed-loop system is established. On the basis of the robust control method and time delay nominal point technique, the exponential uncertainty terms in the sampled system model caused by network-induced long time delays are transformed into sums of nominal terms and norm-bounded uncertainties. Then, by employing the Lyapunov-Krasovskii method, linear matrix inequalities (LMls) technique and discrete Jensen inequality, sufficient conditions for the existence of the H∞ state feedback controller are derived, which guarantee that the augmented closed-loop system is stable and satisfies the prescribed H∞ tracking performance. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of BUCK Circuit Based on Hybrid Automata
abstract: A hybrid automata control method with parameter identification is proposed for the control problem of switching converters. According to the hybrid theory, the hybrid automata model of BUCK circuit is established. Based on the operating characteristics of the circuit, a more concise state switching condition is designed, and the CCM and DCM of the converter are unified in the model. In view of the problem that the hybrid automata model can not stabilize the output voltage when the load is abrupt, the online parameter identification method is used to estimate and correct the system parameters to ensure the output is stable. The simulation experiment shows that the proposed method can stabilize the output voltage for sudden load changes.

articleTitle: Human-Machine Interaction Control System of a Remote Maintenance Manipulator for Tokamak
abstract: This paper presents the development of human-machine interaction control system of a remote maintenance manipulator for tokamak utilizing virtual reality. The human-machine interaction control system aims to achieve three major functions as virtual simulation, human-machine interaction, and collision detection. The graphical user interface of the control system is developed with the aid of the software Unity3D. In order to simplify system operations and improve user experience, 3D mouse and somatosensory controllers are adopted to realize scene exploration in the virtual environment and master-slave interaction control of the manipulators. A typical maintenance task is simulated using the human-machine interaction control system. The results indicate that the developed control system can help improve the safety and efficiency of remote maintenance operations significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Fractional Order Control of an Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
abstract: This is a fractional order control algorithm basing on improved particle swarm optimization (chaotic adaptive particle swarm optimization (CAPSO)), which is verified by the single inverted pendulum control system. This method combines the chaos algorithm with inertia weight adjustment of the particle swarm algorithm. And after the chaotic particle swarm initialization, the method exerts chaotic search on the swarms falling into the local optimal particle, namely the optimization of nonlinear inertia weight adjustment method does not only improve the convergence accuracy of the algorithm, but get the global optimum solution. The Experimental results show that the CAPSO algorithm is better than the dominant pole method and the particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) in the parameter tuning of the fractional order controller. Compared with PSO algorithm, it has many merits of the fast convergence speed, small overshoot, good stability and strong anti-interference. the Dynamic response of the system with fractional order controller optimized by CAPSO algorithm is better than that with integer order PID controller.

articleTitle: UAV Flight Reappearance and Failure Analysis
abstract: This paper described a study for the UAV flight replay and UAV fault analysis. The flight data processing was done by MATLAB. The three-dimensional model established by AC3D was imported into FlightGear. This study achieved the flight simulation visualization and replayed the arbitrary time period data of UAV flight trajectory and attitude. This study was used for crash failure analysis in UAV dynamic test, which can improve UAV flight performance, shorten r&d period and improve development efficiency, thereby broadening UAV research perspective.

articleTitle: Security-Enhanced Relay and Jammer Selection for Energy-Harvesting IoT Networks
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT), which can provide ubiquitous intelligence and pervasive interconnections to a variety of devices, is becoming a vital component of building the intelligent world. In this work we propose a new relay and jammer selection method to improve physical layer security (PLS) and energy efficiency for the IoT network with energy harvesting (EH) devices. In this method, the intermediate nodes are allowed to use time switching (TS) protocol to harvest energy from power transfer stations (PTS). By taking the channel gain between the PTSs and the intermediate nodes into consideration, two intermediate nodes are selected as relay and jammer respectively to transmit confidential and jamming signals to the destination and eavesdropper aiming at minimizing the secrecy outage probability (SOP). We further analyze the secrecy outage of the system and derive the closed-form expression of SOP. Simulation results demonstrate the performance gain of the proposed method.

articleTitle: One- Dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks Based on Exponential Linear Units for Bearing Fault Diagnosis
abstract: Rolling bearings are one of the most commonly used components in rotating machinery which is mainly operated in complex working environment. Therefore, it is of great theoretical value and practical significance to study the state monitoring and fault diagnosis technology of rolling bearing to avoid sudden accidents and make a better system maintenance. In this paper, we propose a one-dimensional convolutional neural network to identify rolling bearing fault. Furthermore, we adopt a novel activation function: exponential linear units in the task of rolling bearing fault diagnosis. Simulation results show that one-dimensional convolutional neural network has a prominent generalization ability and high accuracy rate. Exponential linear units can make neural network more robust and stable when we diagnose the rolling bearing fault.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of the Wind Farm Dispatch Problem Using Chaotic NSGA-II Algorithm
abstract: During the process of wind farm load dispatch, frequent changes of start-up and shut-down state will bring large hardware loss. The pitch angle control system is applied to adjust the power generation of wind turbine. If the allocated power of a wind turbine is far less than the available power generation, the large control pressure will bring large loss to the pitch angle control system. In order to reduce the hardware loss of wind turbines in the dispatching process, a multi-objective optimal dispatching model is established, which takes the times of startup and shut-down and the mean of the power limited index as the objective functions. The optimized chaotic algorithm of tent map is integrated into the NSGA-II algorithm to develop the chaotic NSGA-II (CNSGA-II) algorithm. The results of numerical simulations verify that the CNSGA-II algorithm has better search efficiency and convergence performance. The CNSGA-II algorithm is used to solve the wind farm load dispatch problem. The experimental results demonstrated the validity and correctness of the model and prove the convergence performance superiority of CNSGA-II algorithm over the NSGA- II algorithm.

articleTitle: Face and Lip-Reading Authentication System Based on Android Smart Phones
abstract: In all biometrics, face features are widely used because of their advantages. Compared with other biological features, the recognition accuracy based on face features is not very high, and the system is easy to be deceived by photos. Identity authentication based on multi-modal biometric fusion has opened up a new field of development, which has higher technical requirements and better application performance than single biometric recognition and authentication system. As a dynamic feature, lip reading feature is not easy to imitate, and can be collected with face information at the same time, so it has high convenience. Fusion of lip reading and face information can improve the accuracy of the authentication system, at the same time, greatly enhance the anti-counterfeiting ability of the recognition system. In this paper, Linear Preserving Projection (LPP)is used to extract face features, and Projection Local Spatiotemporal Descriptor (PLSD)is used to extract lip reading features. In Android smart phone platform, face and lip reading are fused by Extreme Learning Machine, which improves the applicability of multi-biometric identity authentication system. The multimode authentication system improves the information security of mobile phone users.

articleTitle: Pattern Recognition (PR) Based a New Control Approach for a Kind of Complex Processes
abstract: For a kind of complex production processes, a new control method is proposed based on pattern recognition technology. It avoids structure design or parameter identification of a system model or controller. First of all, the moving trajectory is predicted through the classification of system pattern samples constructed by input-output classes. And then it is approximately described by a straight-line model. According to the model the system input of a class is obtained. At last, experimental simulations demonstrate the validity of the proposed control method and analysis of parameters affecting control performance is presented.

articleTitle: Pulsar Signal Denoising Method Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition and Independent Component Analysis
abstract: This paper introduces a novel EMD-ICA denoising method, where relevant modes are selected using a hausdorff distance (HD) measure between the probability density function (pdf) of the input and that of each mode. Then, the first layer intrinsic modal function (IMF) is used to construct multidimensional input vectors. These multidimensional input vectors are used as the input of ICA to realize the filtering of each layer of IMF with aliasing. Numerical simulation was carried out to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Simulation and test results show its superior performance over other traditional denoising methods in whole.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Control Method Based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: With the increase of system dimensions, the difficulty of decoupling increases exponentially and the controller becomes more difficult to design. A reinforcement learning framework combined with tradition control method is presented to get rid of decoupling trouble and simplified controller design. A Markov decision process of basis weight and moisture control is explicitly defined. A first-order Pade approximation is applied to solve the time delay problem in reinforcement learning. With the proposed design, the control scheme could obtain a good performance of the control system as same as the PID & feedforward decoupling control through cooperative control. Numerical simulations are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Image Denoising of Subway Tunnel Cracks Based on Gauss-Fast Median Method
abstract: A new Gaussian-fast median filtering algorithm is proposed to filter the image of tunnel cracks in view of the shortcomings of the traditional method of filtering the cracks in the subway tunnel. The algorithm calculates the weighted average value for the image filter template window, and compares the pixel gray value of each point in the image to the weighted mean value. If the pixel gray value of the point is greater than its weighted average value, the fast algorithm of median filter algorithm is used to process it, otherwise the gauss filter algorithm is used to process it. By comparing with median and gauss filtering results, the new algorithm proposed effectively reduces the image noise and improves the image quality, effectively protects the edge of image cracks, shortens the processing time and improves the efficiency greatly, and provides the foundation for subsequent crack recognition and segmentation. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has a good balance between the processing speed and the effect. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by the same segmentation method.

articleTitle: Identification of the Model of Acoustic Feedback Path in Active Noise Control
abstract: Active noise control is used to deal with noise pollution in many fields, and it reduces the noise intensity by generating an antisound which has the same amplitude and opposite phase to the original noise. However, the antisound is a secondary sound source compared to the original noise, and it influences the performances of the active noise control. The sound sensor detects original noise and the antisound simultaneously, in order to cancel the influence of the antisound, this paper proposes a method to identify the model of the acoustic feedback path between the secondary sound source and the sound error sensor. This paper uses a finite impulse response filter to express the model of the above acoustic feedback path. It designs an offline experiment without original noise to identify the model individually. In the experiment, it generates white noise as the antisound and uses recursive least squares algorithm to identify the parameters of the model. It deduces the formula of the identification and analyzes the results of the experiment. The experiment results show that the proposed method model the acoustic feedback model accurately.

articleTitle: Research on spark detection and extinguishing technology in Material Delivery Pipeline
abstract: On basis of the study of the mechanism of the spark generation in the pipeline material, the paper provides a mathematical relation model of the multi parameter spark detection, pointing at the difficult detection of the spark detection and misdiagnosing in the pipeline materials. By using the information collection and signal processing technology based on the photovoltaic effect, the photoelectric detection circuit is optimized to improve the inspection. According to the sensitivity and reliability of the measurement, combining the characteristics of pipeline material transportation, the paper provides the strategy of high sensitivity spark detection and extinguishing.

articleTitle: Measurement Method of the Air Miss Distance and ExplosionDistance of Proximity Fuse
abstract: In order to measure the air distance and the explosion distance in anti-aircraft firing proximity fuse, an optical measuring method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a mathematical model in the three-dimensional relative coordinate based on the same-frame is established. T, based on the maximum likelihood estimation, the solution to the mathematical model is given. Finally, an optimal disposition scheme is put forward. The simulation results analysis and range actual data processing both indicate the effectiveness of the new method. Meanwhile, we provide a flexible disposition of the station which has high engineering value.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Electric Vehicle Torque Observer Based on Discrete Wavelet Transform and Least Squares Support Vector Machine Joint Optimization Theory
abstract: In this paper, based on the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and Least Square Support Vector Machine (LSSVM), the torque observer for hybrid electric vehicles (HEV) is established. Data from the benchmarking test is employed as the training sample, and the DWT-LSSVM based multi-layer observer was trained to observe the torque distribution results of hybrid electric vehicles. The DWT -LSSVM based multi-layer observer can accurately offer the control results of the original vehicle and solve the problem that it is difficult to reproduce the control results of the original vehicle completely. The main work is as follows: first, a multi-layer observation model based on DWT-LSSVM is established. Multiple LSSVM modules are used to observe the input signals with different frequency that are decomposed by wavelet method, and wavelet reconstruction method is used to integrate the observation results of different input signals to obtain the final observation result of vehicle torque distribution. Secondly, the cross-validation method is used to optimize the parameters in LSSVM model to ensure the accuracy of model prediction. Thirdly, taking the test data of a four-wheel drive hybrid electric vehicle (4WD-HEV)as an example, the observation model proposed in this paper is compared with the simply LSSVM observation model. The results show that the observation results of the torque observation model based on DWT-LSSVM are better than those by the simply LSSVM observation model. The compare results justify the proposed method can improve the accuracy of torque observation.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Parameter Cooperative Guidance Law for Circular Formation Flight
abstract: Creation of guidance law is of central importance for the development of unmanned vehicles. In this paper, we introduce a novel guidance law for leader free circular multiagents unmanned formation flight. Instead of using an actual leader agent, current guidance law uses a virtual leader, of which the position is known by all other agents and other agents can obtain information about the relative model of leader-follower relation from their neighbor agents. The guidance law is designed to describe the preset time-varying formation, which controls the relative states of the followers and the leader in the directions both parallel to and orthogonal to the line-of-sight, as a replacement of the reference trajectories for the agents to follow. To confirm the validity and performance of current guidance law, a numerical simulation is performed.

articleTitle: Research on the Detection and Multi Threshold Denoising Technology of Weak Infrared Sensing Signal
abstract: The infrared sensing information often belongs to the weak signal in the detection system. In order to detect weak infrared sensing signal effectively, the paper designs a detection system scheme and detecting amplified circuit with the function of temperature compensation, and the detecting amplified circuit can effectively suppress the noise. Based on the above, a wavelet multi-scale and multi threshold processing algorithm of weak sensing information is proposed. In order to reduce the problem of signal distortion caused by general threshold de-noising, the paper uses an improved threshold function. In the de-noising process, the soft and hard threshold functions can be chosen flexibly by setting a constant. The experiment results show that the hardware and software signal processing and de-noising methods have good effect on the detection of weak infrared sensing signals.

articleTitle: Lyapunov Stability Constraining Solution of the Cascaded Inverter Based on Model Predictive Current Control
abstract: Cascaded system is one of the basic components of the power electronic converter in the distributed energy system. However, it may become unstable even each subsystem is stable individually, especially when the film capacitor is used to stabilize DC voltage. At present, the existing objective function of finite control set model predictive control(FCS-MPC) does not conform to the definition of Lyapunov function. Most of the existing stabilization methods are linear control method which based on small signal model. Therefore, these methods may be ineffective to fix large-signal stability issues. Thus, the system cannot be guaranteed to operate stably. In this paper, a Lyapunov stability constraining solution(LSCS) is proposed for the cascaded inverter based on FSC-MPC to improve the system stability in the distributed energy system. First, this approach theoretically presents how to add the Lyapunov stability constraining to the MPC objective function in an analytic way instead of using the traditional `experience based' weight method. In addition, the LSCS-MPC itself is also an improvement to realize constant switching frequency. Finally, the feasibility of the method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Study on Parameter Measurement of Hole-Punched Steel Strip
abstract: Research on parameter detection method of hole-punched steel strip based on machine vision in this paper. First of all, the image of hole-punched steel strip is extracted and processed based on machine vision, which mainly includes smoothing, threshold segmentation and holes edge detection of the image. So that to obtain more details and information from the image. Then the least square method is chosen for the parameter extraction of the hole-punched steel strip. Finally, the feasibility of the parameter measurement method based on machine vision is demonstrated by experiments.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of Steady Flow Bin and Powder Return Based on Sliding Mode
abstract: For the cement grinding process, the circulating fan is the link between pre-grinding and final grinding. Under the condition of constant feed rate and stable granularity and quality, the circulating fan and the two links are regarded as a coordinated system. The control variable of the system is a recirculating fan, and the state variables are steady flow position and return volume. firstly, the neural network was used to establish the model of the system. Then the controller of the model was designed using the sliding mode control system, the stability of the sliding surface is proved by the Lyapunov. Finally, the simulation is carried out using Matlab, and the feasibility, effectiveness of the design method are verified.

articleTitle: Three-loop Feedback Anti-wind Disturbance Control for The VTOL Aircraft without Vector Thrust
abstract: The vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) aircraft without vector thrust can only generate lateral force through attitude adjustment in the takeoff and landing phase. It cannot change the thrust vector to resist lateral wind disturbance. Therefore, its ability of the anti-wind disturbance is weak. For this reason, a new type of anti-wind disturbance control strategy is proposed in this paper. An intermediate loop fed back by the wind disturbance estimator is introduced between the outer loop of position feedback and the inner loop of attitude feedback. The estimation of disturbance acceleration fed back by the intermediate loop corrects the position control command of outer loop feedback so that the thrust control can achieve suppression of the tangential wind disturbance and the inner loop of attitude control can achieve suppression of the lateral wind disturbance. The simulation results show that control strategy proposed in this paper can well estimate and compensate external wind disturbance received by the system.

articleTitle: Research on On-Line Monitoring and Fault Recognition Technology of Intelligent Power Transformer Based on the Internet
abstract: In order to ensure the safety and reliability of power operation of transformer, this paper studies the on-line monitoring and fault recognition technology of intelligent power transformer based on the “Internet +”. The paper mainly completes the hardware and software design of the intelligent measurement and control terminal for on-line monitoring of state parameters, which includes transformer voltage, current, oil temperature, oil level, power, power factor, harmonics, load rate, transformer short-circuit impedance, hot spot temperature rise, etc. And design of online intelligent transformer monitoring system based on GPRS/NB-IOT Internet + technology. This paper constructs an online fault identification model of BP neural network with the collected transformer operating state parameters. The online monitoring and fault identification system design of the transformer has been completed, which provides a specific solution for the practical application of on-line monitoring and artificial intelligence diagnosis of transformer.

articleTitle: Design of PID Servo Controller Based on Improved Weed Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, a servo controller of improved weed optimization algorithm is designed for the shortcomings of the traditional PID controller in parameter adjustment. The parameters of the PID controller were optimized by using the initial method of chaotic reverse learning and the spatial distribution method of Cauchy distribution. The simulation results show that the PID controller has good dynamic and static performance, fast dynamic response, good universality, reliable operation and good robustness to load disturbance.

articleTitle: A Research on Rapid Reconstruction of Water Environment for USV
abstract: The autonomous of Unmanned Surface Vessel strongly relies on accurate water surface map. A reasonable reconstruction leads to efficiency obstacle avoidance and path planning. We propose an improved water surface map reconstruction method for USVs. This method precisely recovers the obstacle projection exterior from LIDAR in complex environments such as the harbor area. Furthermore, we realize a more efficient path planning based on this reconstruction. We test our method on simulation and realworld data set. The result shows that the method we proposed is more accurate for environment reconstruction and improves the performance of path planning.

articleTitle: The machined topography surface characteristics and normal contact experiment investigations
abstract: In the present, the mechanical 3-dimension surface topography was measured for turning, milling and grinding under different roughness. According to the structure of machined surface, using the statistical self-similarity and scale invariance theory, the surface characteristics parameters are studied. The results show that machined rough surface has fractal characteristics and rough surface profile height is obey normal distribution. At last, the relationship between normal contact stiffness and load is obtained by experiment. The results show that the relationship between normal contact stiffness and load is nonlinear.

articleTitle: The Current Situation Analysis of High Precision Positioning and Research on Implementation of Lane Level Monitoring of Providing Ground
abstract: In order to achieve stable and reliable lane level positioning, and improve the safety and management level of proving ground, this paper mainly made a systematic summary and elaboration of the various positioning methods that meet the high precision positioning requirements of lane level at present, and the advantages and disadvantages of various positioning methods were compared and analyzed. On this basis, a lane level location scheme for proving ground is proposed, combined with lane level high precision map, to realize to monitor the whole test process of the proving ground. In this way, the accident probability of the proving ground will be reduced and the running efficiency will be improved.

articleTitle: LQG Control for a Class of Complex Disturbance Systems Based on Kalman Filter
abstract: Because of the large inertia, load uncertainty and random disturbance, it is difficult to track the control signal quickly and accurately. Problems such as frequent oscillations, overshoot, long regulation time, and course deviation often occur. The difficulty of course control increases with the increase of system complexity and the superposition of disturbance with different characteristics. The ship's load determines the draught depth. The draught depth determines the size of the steering gear load. The steering gear load directly affects the dynamic and static tracking accuracy of the rudder blade. In order to overcome the uncertainty of ship load and the random disturbance of wave, current and wind, and to realize the fast and accurate control of course, a general mathematical description of the system with uncertain disturbance and stochastic disturbance is presented. A linear quadratic Gauss control method based on Kalman filter is presented. The simulation results show that the rudder blade angle of the linear quadratic Gaussian (LQG) ship steering gear control system based on Kalman filter can track the given angle quickly and accurately, and has good restraining ability to random disturbance and uncertain load disturbance.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Droop Control for IC Considering Voltage-Frequency Correlation Coefficient
abstract: For ac side and dc side of IC, there are different droop characteristics. The power balance on both sides needs to be considered, so as to unify the droop characteristics of both sides. In this paper, according to ac and dc power operating characteristics, combined with virtual synchronous generator features and virtual capacitance characteristics of IC, a novel hybrid droop control for IC is presented, which associates de voltage with ac frequency. According to droop characteristic in individual microgrids, the reference value of power flow on both ac and dc sides is obtained, making the power of both sides support each other. Finally, a simulation model is built in Matlab/Simulink in this paper. Three typical modes are simulated and analyzed. The simulation results verify that the control strategy could couple the ac frequency and dc voltage, making the power flow on both ac and dc sides and maintaining the power balance of hybrid microgrid.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy for Photovoltaic/Battery Micro-grid
abstract: In the future, the penetration rate of new energy will gradually increase in the power system. Therefore, the study on the micro-grid with new energy as the main energy supply will be a hot spot. As the most convenient and clean energy form, photovoltaic power generation is becoming the main energy supply in micro grid system. As a key carrier to balance the power fluctuation in micro-grid, energy storage unit is also a hot research topic. This paper mainly studies the structure and control strategy of photovoltaic/battery microgrid system. The system structure and topology of photovoltaic/battery micro-grid are established. A modified variable step length incremental conductance (INC) method is adopted in this article to adapt different environments by designing new velocity factors. Control of DC bus voltage is maintained by the droop control based on the energy storage unit in island mode. In order to reduce the impact to the system equipment in grid-connected time, a secondary control strategy of DC bus voltage is proposed. Adding the deviation compensation term of DC bus voltage to droop control, can achieve DC bus voltage regulation in island mode and realize the seamless switching of grid/off-grid pattern. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Sliding Mode Control of Cement Decomposing Furnace Based on T-S Fuzzy Model
abstract: Aiming at the control problem of cement decomposing furnace outlet temperature, the T-S fuzzy model and sliding mode variable structure control are combined to propose a sliding mode variable structure control strategy for cement decomposition furnace based on T-S fuzzy model. The sliding surface based on the combined approach law is constructed, and the controller design process is given to avoid the chattering problem of the sliding mode before and during the sliding mode and the traditional sliding mode. The Lyapunov stability theorem is used to guarantee the global asymptotic stability of the system state. Finally, the Matlab simulation shows that the controller is effective and robust.

articleTitle: Extraction of Electromyographic Signals for Multiple-Hand-Motion Recognition via Sparse Representation Technique
abstract: In order to improve recognition accuracies of hand multi-movement patterns, we investigate a feature extraction method based on sparse representation technique. As a new tool, sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) algorithm is adopted to reveal the hidden nonstationary characteristics of surface electromyography (sEMG) during multiple different wrist, hand and finger movements. In the experiment on classifying these movements for fifteen participants, the feature we proposed has the optimal class separability. It can effectively distinguish multiple different hand movements. The average correct recognition rate of ten movements is up to 89.40%. Meanwhile, Davies-Bouldlin index (DBI) is applied to evaluate the performance of proposed method for identifying hand multi-movement patterns. The experiment results suggest that the SBL based method is an effective tool to capture the hidden characteristics of sEMG signals during ten different movements. Using the proposed method, the performance of myoelectric pattern recognition is enhanced.

articleTitle: Design of a Class of Six Degrees of Freedom Parallel Robot Control System
abstract: A kind of six-degree-of-freedom slider type parallel robot is designed. Based on the structural characteristics and working principle of the parallel robot, the slider-type parallel robot control system based on Visual Studio is designed. Firstly, according to the structural characteristics of the slider-type parallel robot, the overall scheme of the control system design is given. The control system is analyzed from two aspects of software design and hardware design, and the example is verified. The verification results show that the displacement of each slider is consistent with the actual displacement of each slider of the robot by inverse kinematics within the error tolerance. Basic functions such as sports and teaching teaching can be realized, and the research has broad application prospects in industrial production.

articleTitle: A Multitask Cascaded Convolutional Neural Network Based on Full Frame Histogram Equalization for Vehicle Detection
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of vehicle detection, a Multitask Cascaded Convolutional Neural Network(MC-CNN) based on Full Frame Histogram Equalization (FFHE) algorithm is proposed. FFHE is used to enhance the image, which can solve the problem of unclear image, low contrast, low overall gray value and uneven illumination when the imaging condition is not ideal. MC-CNN locates and classifies the object in the image. The algorithm first performs FFHE operation on the test datasets. Then the region image containing a single vehicle is obtained by the object location algorithm based on Faster R-CNN. Next, the six classification(bus, microbus, minivan, sedan, SUV, and truck) results of each vehicle are obtained through the object classification algorithm based on CNN. To verify the performance of the algorithm, MC-CNN was trained on BIT-Vehicle and tested on SYIT2018-Vehicle. Compared with Faster R-CNN, the average classification accuracy of our algorithm was improved by 11.5% on SYIT2018-Vehicle dataset.

articleTitle: Feedforward Based Linear Quadratic Optimal Tracking Control for a Class of Heavy Disturbance Systems
abstract: The ship steering system is a typical electro-hydraulic servo system, which has the characteristics of non self-balance, large inertia, heavy load and uncertain disturbance. The load of the ship determines the depth of the draught. The depth of the draught determines the load of the steering system. The load of the rudder directly affects the dynamic and static tracking accuracy of the steering angle of the rudder. Therefore, the ship load is an important part of the ship steering system, and the establishment of a complete and accurate mathematical model is the necessary condition for the accurate control of the system. Based on the characteristics of the ship steering system, a general mathematical description with an uncertain disturbance system is presented. In order to obtain good performance of tracking control and resistance to load disturbance, a feedforward linear quadratic optimal tracking control method is proposed. The ship steering system designed based on this method can not only make the steering angle fast and accurately track the given, but also effectively suppress the heavy load uncertain disturbance. The simulation results show that feedforward linear quadratic optimal tracking control system has good tracking control performance and strong resistance to heavy load disturbance.

articleTitle: A New Training Structure for Multiple-to-Multiple Traffic Flow Prediction
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of multiple-to-multiple traffic flow prediction. In order to better distinguish the differences in different traffic flow, due to the influence of the dispersion between classes in the linear classifier and convolution, we define a new parameter WTT (Weight of Traffic Flow to Temperature Flow) for the classification of different kinds of traffic flow. We also propose a method for training of different classifications of traffic flow data-SCT (Structure of classification training) to train prediction model. Through the experiment, we give empirical parameter of the traffic flow variance corresponding to the best classifier model. Experiment results show that compared with K-means and other traditional clustering methods, WTT can better classify different kinds of traffic flow. Compared with the traditional one-to-one or multiple-to-one prediction models, SCT with WTT can reduce computational complexity well and get a good result for the problem of multiple-to-multiple traffic flow prediction.

articleTitle: Symmetric solution to matrix equation with conjugate and transpose unknown and its application in control
abstract: In this paper, we consider the the symmetric least squares solution to a kind of matrix equation with conjugate and transpose unknown by applying of a modified conjugate gradient least, squares iterative algorithm, which is called on the MCGLS iterative algorithm. In addition, the convergence analysis of the algorithm is proven. Moreover, two examples are offered at the end of this paper for showing the feasible of the MCGLS iterative algorithm.

articleTitle: A new fuzzy adaptive control method for continuous stirred tank reactor
abstract: In the paper, a fuzzy adaptive control strategy is proposed for a class of cascade continuous stirred tank reactor (CSTR) systems with unknow functions based on the universal approximation property of fuzzy logic systems. The controller and adaptive law are designed based on the backstepping method, and the interconnected terms in the system are eliminated by backstepping method. The Lyapunov function is used to prove the closed-loop system is stable. The simulation results prove the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A New Identification Method for Transformer Inrush Current Based on Fast S- transform and Information Entropy
abstract: To settle the problem that identifying inrush current and fault current of large transformer is difficult, a new identification method which is a combination of fast S transform and information entropy theory is come up with. Firstly, the inrush current signals of transformer and fault current signals of different fault types are subjected by fast S transform, extracting the feature information after fast S transform. Secondly, the information entropy of the feature information is calculated. The information entropy of fault current, which is larger than that of inrush current, is a protection criterion for distinguishing inrush current and fault current. Through the simulating tests of transformer with different capacity, the results show that this method can be a reliable method to identify transformer inrush current and fault current. Fast S transform, comparing with traditional S transform, reduces computational complexity greatly, and founds the foundation for the application of the engineering application.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Controller Trained with Dynamic Performance Index and Its Application to 3-DOF Helicopter
abstract: In this paper, the dynamic performance index in the classical control theory is introduced into the reward of reinforcement learning. The incompatibility of large initial error with small operation error when using binary reward are solved. In the simulation experiment based on 3-DOF helicopter platform, the feasibility is proved, and the comparison result between this method and binary rewarding method is given. Experiments show that this method enables the 3-DOF helicopter to track time-varying signals. It can also cope with the large initial error and has better dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Target Detection and Extraction Based on Motion Attention Model
abstract: In the paper, a new motion attention temporal spatial fusion model is constructed for motion object detection and extraction in view of the limitations of target detection and extraction method under global motion scene according to motion attention formation mechanism. In the algorithm, motion vector fields undergo superposition, filtering and other pretreatment firstly. Then, a motion attention fusion model is defined according to temporal - spatial change characteristics of motion vector. The model is adopted for detecting the motion object region. Finally, morphology and boundary following method are utilized for accurate extraction of the object region. The test results of many different global motion video scenes show that the algorithm has better accuracy and real - time performance than other similar algorithms.

articleTitle: Unbiased minimum-variance estimation for systems with measurement-delay and unknown inputs
abstract: This paper considers the problem of simultaneously estimating the state and the unknown input for linear discrete-time systems with measurement delay. Firstly, the reorganized innovation analysis approach is applied to deal with measurement delay and the measurement delay model is converted into a measurement delay free model. A recursive filter where the estimation of the state and the input are interconnected is proposed. Then we utilize the innovation to obtain the unknown input estimator by least-squares estimation and the optimal state estimator is constructed by transforming into a standard Kalman filtering in terms of two Riccati equations with the same dimension as the state model. Finally we give a numerical example to show that our estimation approach is effective.

articleTitle: Zero-Rate Offset Compensation for Dual-Mass Tuning Fork Micro-Machined Gyroscope Based on Back Propagation Neural Network
abstract: For the zero-rate offset of dual-mass tuning fork micro-machined gyroscope (DTMG), back propagation neural network (BPNN) is proposed to compensate the offset. The zero-rate offset data were tested as the training data and the verification data of BPNN. The experimental results prove that this method has strong nonlinear mapping capabilities. And it can effectively reduce the zero-rate offset of DTMG by more than one order of magnitude. Thus, DTMG can be applied to the field of inertial navigation with higher precision.

articleTitle: Online Modeling of Piezoelectric Actuators Based on Non-smooth Sandwich Model with hysteresis
abstract: In order to accurately describe the high-frequency motion characteristics of the Piezoelectric Actuators (PEA), an online modeling method is proposed in this paper. In this identification scheme, a nonlinear discrete hysteretic operator is firstly introduced to handle the non-smoothness and multi-value mapping of the hysteresis. Then, the key term separation technique is employed to obtain a special form of the sandwich model, which its expression is linearized in parameters. Finally, a Recursive General Identification Algorithm (RGIA) is applied to the estimation of the parameters of the sandwich model. The experimental results obtained by implementing the proposed identification scheme are also presented in this paper. It can satisfy the design requirement of the adaptive control the piezoelectric ultra-precision motion systems.

articleTitle: Study on Nonlinear Compensation Control Method for Electronic Throttle Valve
abstract: It is great significance to improve the automobile power characteristics, reduce the emission of the engine and improve the efficiency of fuel utilization by controlling the electronic throttle. In this paper, a nonlinear compensation controller is designed to improve tracking performance and restrain the oscillation caused by nonlinear perturbation. A system computer simulation and hardware in the loop simulation are carried out by simulink box and connecting the electronic throttle to the system to verify the feasibility of the nonlinear compensation controller. The simulation results show that the nonlinear compensation control system is significantly better than traditional PID system. The designed nonlinear compensation control throttle system has shorter regulating time, smaller overshoot and certain robustness.

articleTitle: Transient and quasi-steady state simulation of Czochralski silicon single crystal growth
abstract: In this paper, we established a transient heat transfer model for a Czochralski furnace and compared it with steady-state simulations at different crystal heights. Both simulations showed the same qualitative results in Equal diameter stage with a temperature difference of less than 3K. However, in the shoulder-changing and tailing stages of the diameter change, the temperature, stress distribution, etc. show a qualitative difference between the transient and quasi-steady-state simulations. Therefore, dynamic research is better for strong transient phases with sharp changes in diameter.

articleTitle: Predictive Function Control of Output Probability Density Function
abstract: Randomness is common in many real industrial processes, its modeling problem has always been an important research content in the field of industrial control. Probability density function(PDF) is an effective means to solve the problem of stochastic distributed system modeling This paper based on Bspline basis function sets up the model of output and input data. Due to the fact that there are often many constraints in the actual industrial process and high requirements for real-time and accuracy, this paper proposes to combine the PDF model with predictive control to achieve effective tracking of system output setpoints. Predictive control optimization is more complicated and computationally intensive, so the predictive functional control (PFC) strategy is adopted to reduce the degree of freedom of the optimization problem. Applying PFC based on PDF modeling to the molecular weight distribution (MWD) of the polymerization process, and compared with generalized predictive control (GPC) algorithm, the validity of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: A Convenient Indoor Positioning Method
abstract: It is often difficult for people to reach their destinations When they enter unfamiliar buildings. This brings huge inconvenience to both daily life and emergency cases. However, current indoor positioning methods are not practical because they require deploying a large number of devices within the buildings. In order to solve the existed problem, this paper proposes a positioning method that fuses the data from inertial navigation system, floor plans of buildings and the distributed data of the evacuation signs. This positioning method achieves the required precision with no need for deploying extra devices in the buildings. This paper adopts particle filter to implement the positioning method. Matlab is used to simulate the process of observing, calculating and positioning. The original walking path, observed path and predicted path were provided through the simulation. Positioning error is also simulated to evaluate the accuracy. According to the results, the proposed positioning method can truly reduce the positioning error compared with the previous methods. This paper also simulates the effects on positioning error from the number of particles, the radius of particle distribution, the relative weight of evacuation signs and the recognition rate. Results and analysis are provided in this article.

articleTitle: Total Principal Component Regression Based Contribution Plots for Quality-Related Process Monitoring
abstract: Common partial least squares (PLS) is used to a power way in the multivariate statistical process monitoring filed for the past two decades. However, PLS takes an incomplete decomposition that fails to work well in the quality-related fault detection and diagnosis. To address this situation, In this paper, to solve these problems, total principal component analysis (TPCR) is analyzed in detail which can separate the process variables into two specific portions, the quality-related portion and quality-unrelated portion. Statistics of TPCR are designed to offer the detection results regarding abnormal conditions. To figure out the fault-related variables, the calculation of the contribution of variables is given based on the contribution plots. A corresponding control limit is determined to recognize fault corresponding variables. Furthermore, the fault diagnosis logic is proposed in this paper. Finally, the Tennessee Eastman (TE) model is taken as an example to prove the performance of TPCR in quality-related process monitoring.

articleTitle: Consensus Tracking of Linear Multi-agent Systems Via Iterative Learning Control with Feedback Time-Delay
abstract: In this paper, we propose a proportional differential (PD) type iterative learning control (ILC) algorithm with feedback time-delay for the consensus tracking of multi-agent systems. The communication topology graph contains a spanning tree with the leader being its root. Using graph theory and operator theory, convergence condition is obtained. The result of the convergence analysis ensures that the agents follow the reference trajectory perfectly. Simulations show that the proposed algorithm has faster convergence speed than PD type ILC algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Global Best Imperialist Competition Algorithm for Multi-objective Reactive Power Optimization
abstract: This study proposes a multi-objective global best imperialist competition algorithm (MOGBICA) for solving two dual-objective reactive power optimization problems. Previous research has shown that imperialist competition algorithm (ICA) has certain advantages in solving optimization problems. However, the original ICA often converges to local optima. The global best imperialist country solution is proposed to enhance the searching capability of ICA. In addition, the nondominated sorting and crowding distance methods are employed to solve multi-objective optimization problems (MOPs). The proposed approaches is studied and evaluated on the IEEE 30 bus system. The obtained results show that the MOGBICA provides better results than MOPSO and MOICA algorithm.

Author Keywords: multi-objective global best imperialist competition algorithm

articleTitle: Controller Design of Equivalent-Input-Disturbance System based on H-infinity
abstract: A methodology of the the Equivalent-Input-Disturbance control system based on H-infinity (H∞) is proposed in this paper. This design method aims to solve the problem that the parameters of the control system lack unified standard to set. It converts the controller design problem into a convex optimization problem with LMI constraints. The parameters of the control system are obtained by using the LMI toolbox in Matlab. Firstly, the model of the Equivalent-Input-Disturbance system containing state feedback controller is built; secondly, the controller design problem is transformed into a standard H∞ state-feedback design problem and a mathematical model of the transformed H∞ standard control model is established; finally, under the H∞ formulation, the state feedback gain is obtained by solving the LMI constraint inequations and the stability is considered based on the small gain theorem. Simulation results show that the proposed method is effective and easy to implement.

articleTitle: Research on Permanent Magnet Electromagnetic Hybrid Suspension System Based on Joint Structure about Fault Tolerant Control
abstract: This paper studies the sensor problem and the control of high-speed permanent magnet and electromagnetic hybrid magnetic train suspension. The suspension system model with joint structure is established. The tracking-differentiator (TD) is applied to acquire the gap differential signal to replace the integrated signal of acceleration sensor signal. The method of control algorithm reconstruction is applied to the current sensor. At the same time, for fault of single-side actuator, the other controller is used, which is designed according to the mathematical model under fault situation. And the simulation of above all illustrate availability of the method.

articleTitle: AUV Dynamic Docking Based on Longitudinal Safety Speed
abstract: Aiming at the recovery requirements of Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV), a scheme for recycling AUVs through dynamic docking between mother-vehicle and AUV was proposed. Considering the difficulty of communication, a detailed non-cooperative dynamic docking scheme was designed, including three stages: searching segment, approaching segment, and docking segment. In order to avoid the risk of collision due to excessive speed when the AUV docks with the mother-vehicle, different reference quantities are selected according to the features of the various docking stages to design a safe longitudinal desired speed so that the AUV can approach the mother-vehicle as quickly as possible and with safety speed enters docking station. In the end, the simulation of the AUV approaching the mother-vehicle and the completion of the docking process is simulated. The simulation results show that the designed docking scheme and tracking control system are reasonable and effective. As the position deviation decreases, the longitudinal speed of the AUV gradually transitions to the speed of the mother-vehicle.

articleTitle: Big Data Analyzing for Control Valve Using the Spark Cluster Computing Engine
abstract: Control valve plays an important role in modern industry, where the production depends on distributing and controlling fluid accurately. With the development of automation and Internet technology, control valves can collect real-time signals and store large amount of historical data, which is difficult to analyze and utilize. In this paper, we use the Spark cluster computing engine (Spark) to realize a fault diagnosis approach based on big data for control valve. Firstly, we use the data visualizing algorithm t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) to observe the distribution of control valve data. Then we implement a parallel Searching Density Peaks (SDP) cluster algorithm combined with Spark MapReduce for fault detection. Experimental results demonstrate that the parallel algorithm based on Spark can process big data fast and efficiently.

articleTitle: Data Prediction Compensation for Dynamic Target Tracking System Based on BP Neural Network
abstract: During the target tracking process, some observation data may be missing due to the equipment problems or the operation errors, which may affect the filtering process of the target state and the position determination accuracy. Therefore, the missing data needs to be effectively compensated. This paper provides a method to compensate the missing data by using the characteristics of BP neural network learning system aiming at the dynamic target tracking system. The neural network is trained by using the complete data of the dynamic system, and then the missing data is predicted by the trained neural network. The simulation results for both of the linear system and the nonlinear system show that the method is indeed effective, compared to the traditional time update prediction, the prediction accuracy is much higher.

articleTitle: Development of monitoring system for Thermal Energy consumption in Intelligent Home
abstract: The thermal energy consumption monitoring system for smart home is mainly based on embedded terminal module, integrated sensor technology, automation control technology, LAN communication technology, computer technology and network communication technology, mainly used for terminal control. That is, after entering the home to control the flow control system. The monitoring equipment such as sensor and electric adjusting valve are connected to ZigBee LAN through terminal node, and the information is collected again. Through serial port connection technology, users can adjust the flow rate of heating pipe to the room conveniently and quickly, achieving the purpose of controlling indoor temperature. To achieve the goal of saving energy and reducing consumption, protecting the environment and improving the utilization rate of resources. Therefore, the application of embedded system in the intelligent home heating system has a very broad prospect.

articleTitle: Finite-time H∞ Control of Continuous Switched Nonlinear Systems
abstract: This study aims to investigate the problem of finite-time H∞ control for continuous switched nonlinear systems. Firstly, we extend finite-time stability (FTS) and finite-time boundedness (FTB) to switched nonlinear systems. Secondly, in terms of the multiple Lyapunov functions and average dwell time (ADT) approach, some sufficient conditions are obtained to guarantee that the systems are finite-time bounded and satisfy a given H∞ performance. Finally, two examples are given to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Implementation of Self-Adaptive Fuzzy Strategy Applied in STM32-based BLDCM Control System
abstract: This paper describes the application of a kind of self-adaptive fuzzy strategy in the brushless DC motor (BLDCM) control system, which is based on STM32 chip and the corresponding designs of hardware and the software of the whole BLDCM control system are established respectively. From the data tested by the HALL sensor in the motor, several sets of experimental results are obtained. These results show that the proposed fuzzy-based BLDCM control system has lower overshoot, stronger anti-interference ability and better performance in speed response than the conventional BLDCM control system in which the traditional PI controller is used.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Temperature Field Analysis of Copper-skin Pulse Inductor Based on Skin Effect
abstract: The copper-skin pulse inductor serve the function of adjusting the wave and changing the current pulse width of the pulse power supply (PPS).
