When the PPS discharges the inductor will continue working under the condition of a large current, It temperature will continuously rise due to the Joule heat effect of the current. This temperature rise is a challenge to the heat-proof property of the insulating material between the layers of copper skin of the inductors. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct research on the inductor temperature rise. According to its actual working conditions and the skin effect of the current, this paper proposes on analytical expression of its temperature distribution, and presents a finite-element model, The ANSYS is used to simulate the electromagnetic-temperature coupling of the inductor. The results of analysis and test of its temperature distribution show that proposes the analytical expression is correct.

articleTitle: Generalized Iterative Closet Point Algorithm Based on Lie Algebra Parameterization
abstract: The Generalized Iterative Closest Point(G-ICP) algorithm is a high-precision point cloud registration algorithm, which uses Euler angles to parameterize a rotation matrix. However, Euler angle parameterization has singularity at a specific angle, which leads to application limitations. In this paper, a new G-ICP algorithm has been proposed, in which the Lie algebra on so(3) is used to parameterize a rotation matrix and the Gauss-Newton method is employed to optimize the objective function of the G-ICP algorithm. The experimental results have demonstrated that our method performs well compared with the state-of-the-art G-ICP alorithm [1] and simultaneously holds better estimation accuracy of pose with fast convergence speed in the open RGB-D TUM datasets.

articleTitle: Research and Design on Lightweight Automotive Ethernet FQTSS Protocol
abstract: In view of the problem that the current automotive Ethernet AVB protocol stack cannot fully adapt to the vehicle network environment, optimization about the FQTSS protocol in Ethernet AVB is focused on in this paper. Considering the status of current automotive Ethernet AVB protocols stack is conservative, a lightweight Ethernet AVB platform is designed and implemented in this paper. With reference to the relevant standards and specifications given by the AVnu Alliance, a hardware test platform based on STM32 is built. Then, combined with the improved LwIP protocol stack and μC/OS-II operating system, a solution about low-cost, low-overhead, low-latency lightweight automotive Ethernet FQTSS protocol is proposed and implemented. Finally, some necessary test is executed to verify the feasibility of the solution.

articleTitle: Partial Least Squares Method Based on Double Mutual Information and its Application
abstract: As we all know, PCA algorithm provides a linear transformation matrix between high and low dimensions, which is processed with dimensionality reduction by means of projection, so as to intercept the main information useful to people. However, the PCA algorithm does not take into account that its residuals may also contain process variables closely related to quality. Therefore, no matter what is done with the extracted ingredients, it is possible to lose important information. PLS considers the deficiencies of PCA and is widely used in quality control systems. However, since there will be non-gaussian interference in the system, the covariance method of the original PLS does not adapt to system interference. Therefore, we propose a PLS method based on double mutual information (DMIPLS) to solve the above problems. This method first use mutual information to calculate the weighted mutual information between process variables X and quality variables Y, select a set of process variables X, which are closely related to the quality variables, to ensure that the following PLS have valid process variables. Then, in the second to calculate the mutual information between residual matrix, to ensure that the residual error matrix of the process variables related to quality is not missing. The problem of non-gaussian interference is solved by using the feature of mutual information. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by the simulation of TE system.

articleTitle: Absolute Stability of the Fifth-Order Lurie Direct Control Systems
abstract: This paper mainly uses Popov frequency criterion to discuss the absolute stability of some 5th-order direct control systems. Some necessary and sufficient conditions for the absolute stability of the zero solution of these systems under some conditions are given.

articleTitle: Height data fusion based on the information of ultrasonic array sensor and SINS/GPS
abstract: A VAV ground height measurement system based on ultrasonic array sensor and SINS/GPS is proposed. First, a new ultrasonic array sensor is designed. On the basis of the altitude of the last time, the height of the current time can be obtained with the acceleration and velocity information of SINS/GPS. Then, with the combination of the measurement height of ultrasonic array sensor to the federated information fusion. According to the working characteristics of the two systems, dynamic distribution coefficients are adopted. Finally, the simulation of the altitude measurement system is carried out. The simulation results show that the system can measure the height of VAV effectively and it has the application value in engineering.

articleTitle: A Parameter Optimization Method of ADRC by Adaptive Multi-Population Genetic Algorithm
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the parameters of the auto disturbance rejection controller are hard to be set, this article has presented an improved adaptive multi-population genetic algorithm for parameter tuning of ADRC. Multiple population co-evolution was used to replace the traditional single population evolution, and an adaptive parameter model is applied to the multi-population genetic algorithm. Considering the dynamic performance and control requirements of the controller, an evaluation function is established. The course control of unmanned ship is simulated as an example. The simulation results show that the proposed optimization method in this article can improve the response speed and control accuracy of the ADRC obviously, and it has certain effectiveness and practicability.

articleTitle: Sensor-target assignment algorithm based on complementary principle
abstract: Aiming at the problem of target assignment in sensor management, a new method based on the principle of complementarity was proposed. This method takes the threat index of the battlefield as the premise, takes information entropy as the judgment criterion and combines the sensor efficiency to optimize the combination. When a single sensor fails to reach the basic entropy threshold, the nearby sensors are selected according to the constraint of distance and sensor efficiency factors. This method not only combines the information gain theory and the efficiency theory to carry out the comprehensive target assignment, but also has a small amount of computation. It can quickly set up sensor groups, which is suitable for large-scale sensor networks in large clusters.

articleTitle: Static Bifurcation Control of Power System
abstract: Due to the influence of various factors such as the environment, the operating state of the power system is becoming more and more severe. The development of the theory of branching brings an opportunity to solve the power system problem including voltage stability. Moreover, static bifurcation is closely related to power system voltage instability, voltage collapse and power angle instability. This paper reviews the research status of power system bifurcation control theory, and focuses on the discriminant theory and control method of static bifurcation such as saddle node bifurcation, and analyzes its theoretical basis and algorithm system. Then combined with a simple system to illustrate the specific operation steps of the power system bifurcation control, using a stability analysis method of the PID closed-loop control system, the example shows that the system is globally stable. Finally, the simulation results show that the method can achieve effective control effects.

articleTitle: Self-adjusting Desensitized EKF-SLAM System for Autonomous Mobile Robot
abstract: SLAM has become the core method of robot positioning, but SLAM based on EKF method cannot solve the filter sensitivity problem caused by uncertain parameters. This paper proposed a self-adjusting desensitized EKF-SLAM system based on the Desensitised EKF which momentarily adjusts the emphasis on the sensitivity in the cost function. This algorithm utilizes the comparison of systematic theoretical residual and practical innovation to construct the weight factor of the sensitivity in the cost function, which adjusts the sensitivity weight online so as to realize the adaptive estimation of the desensitized Kalman filter. This method is applied to the EKF-SLAM system to overcome the degradation of system performance caused by systemic sensitivity to uncertain parameters from the odometer. Finally, the results from the outdoorsy experiment demonstrate the performance of the proposed desensitized EKF-SLAM system.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Modeling and Asymptotic Stabilizing for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor System
abstract: In this paper, a fractional order model for speed and current control of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is presented. Meanwhile, fractional order sliding mode control (SMC) is introduced to control the currents of d-axis and q-axis. First, a fractional-order model of permanent magnet synchronous motor is established. The effect of fractional order on the chaotic attractor is analyzed. Second, sliding mode type controller is introduced for current control. The presented control scheme, which contains current error, it is simple and flexible to implement in engineering. The desired q-axis current is designed by using the Lyapunov approach, the asymptotic stability of the closed loop is guaranteed with control term. Finally, numerical simulations are provided to illustrate that the obtained scheme is efficient and robust against external interference for controlling the fractional-order PMSM system.

articleTitle: Joint Template Matching by Candidate Set Voting
abstract: To jointly match multiply images for one specific object has more and more applications in practice. In this paper, given a small annotated subset as templates, we propose to jointly match a series target images by a novel idea: selecting the initial matching results by the bidirectional voting between template set and candidate set. In our method, firstly, the forward pairwise matching from template set to target set is performed. These matching results are denoted as candidates. When multiply results appear for one target, that means the matching results are inconsistent. Then, a novel screening method is proposed by the backward matching and voting, until all results reach consistent. Experiments conducted on various moving objects in the wild demonstrate the proposed method can overcome the matching difficulty by a single template and improve the matching accuracy under complex conditions.

articleTitle: Quality-based Process Monitoring with Parallel Regularized Canonical Correlation Analysis
abstract: Canonical correlation analysis (CCA) is a representative quality-relevant algorithm of multivariate statistical monitoring method. Different from PLS, CCA focus on extracting the correction between input and output data, which brings strong predictive ability. However, CCA ignores the variance of variables, which makes it more sensitive to noises. In addition, CCA suffers from collinearity problems that exists in process and quality data. In order to solve these problems, regularized parallel canonical correlation analysis is proposed. Firstly, regularization terms are inserted into constraint conditions of objective function. To remove the effect of noises, l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>minimization is applied on the correction matrix to eliminate zero or near-zero terms. The original data is decomposed into four subspaces: correlation subspace, input-relevant subspace, output-principal subspace and output-residual subspace. Besides, four corresponding monitoring statistics and control limits are then developed. Finally, numerical simulations are used to indicate the effectiveness of regularized PCCA.

articleTitle: Research on the safety assessment of operation of distribution network based on the timing characteristics
abstract: Distribution network is a kind of development mode of smart distribution network in the future. It is an effective method for efficient use and optimization of resources. The comprehensive evaluation of grid operation is of great significance to the safe operation of power grid. Based on Smart Grid D400, introducing economic, quality, safety and cleanness as four indexes, it builds a comprehensive evaluation index. Based on the evaluation methods of fuzzy theory, gravity method, and the weight value determination method of analytic hierarchy process and entropy, it establishes a comprehensive evaluation model combining qualitative and quantitative. Through the analysis of Siping Grid application verification, research shows that comprehensive evaluation index data is easy to obtain, and this model can accurately reflect the actual characteristics of the grid operation.

articleTitle: Passivity-based Fault Detection for semi-Markov Jump Systems with Time-varying Delays
abstract: This paper investigates the passivity-based fault detection of semi-Markov jump systems with time-varying delays. By constructing the filter type residual generator and model transformation, the augmented error system is first established. Then, by means of Lyapunov-Krasovskii approach, fault detection conditions are given such that the augmented error systems can satisfy the passivity performance. The desired fault detection gains can be obtained with the help of matrix techniques. The simulation example is presented to show the validity of the design method.

articleTitle: Fault Trend Prediction Based on A Combined Fault Model for Catalyst Deactivation
abstract: Fault trend prediction can indicate future fault process changing trend and help operators to remove serious process fault in advance. The existing process fault prediction methods are often based on the empirical linear model, which is inappropriate for the nonlinear catalyst deactivation fault. In order to forecast the process deterioration trend accurately, a fault trend prediction method based on a combined fault model is proposed. Firstly, an improved process fault model is developed by combining the empirical model and catalyst deactivation fault mechanism. Then, Kalman filter is used to estimate fault model parameters. Future process changing trend is forecasted by performing the fuzzy adaptive unscented Kalman predictor. Simulations on a continuous stirred reactor show that the proposed method can predict process changing trend under the catalyst deactivation condition more accurately.

articleTitle: NU-WAY, an Application of Numerical Methods in Campus Running Route Evaluation
abstract: Over the years, campus circulatory run and campus marathons have gone viral in many Chinese universities, which calls for the accuracy of route measurement. Traditional methods of distance measurement apply GPS positioning and distance evaluation, which is more displacement-based, leading to our thinking whether it is applicable to solve distance measurement from speed with numerical methods. Meanwhile, many popular sporting applications on phones and GPS provide ways for relative accurate speed measurement. Therefore, this work integrates sporting applications with numerical fitting and integration methods to calculate the circumference of campus and used Zijingang Campus of Zhejiang University as an example. With such methods as Least Square Fitting, Compound Trapezoid Integration, Compound Simpson Integration and Romberg Integration applied, the results indicate the circumference of Zijingang Campus ranges from 3758.18m to 3767.13m, corresponding well with the results given by GPS-based sporting application, which shows the effectiveness of numerical analytical methods.

articleTitle: The Improved Second-order Sliding Mode for Electric Vehicle Steering Systems
abstract: A new improved second-order sliding mode control algorithm is proposed for the trajectory tracking control problem of electric vehicle steering system. In this paper, the second order sliding mode control is further improved, and the control law in each region is considered by means of partitioning the state space. Considering the controlled variable and its first order and second derivative, it can make better use of the known information of the system so as to better control the controlled quantity. Finally, the simulation and experiment results prove that the proposed control system is correct and feasible. It can improve electric vehicle steering performance.

articleTitle: An Soft Crowbar Control Approach for Fault Ride-Through Enhancement in Doubly Fed Induction Wind Power Generation
abstract: In this paper, based on the classical stator field orientation and power decoupling control system for the DFIG problem of DFIG system, a soft crowbar control method combining demagnetization control and virtual damping control is proposed. Firstly, the DFIG model is described, and the damage of the grid fault to DFIG is analyzed. Then, the theory basis and the implementation method of the soft crowbar control approach are provided. Finally, compared with 3 different method, the simulation on a 1.5MW DFIG system with soft crowbar control approach are given. It shows that the proposed soft crowbar method is effective and makes the DFIG system highly adaptive and robust.

articleTitle: Design of Comprehensive Monitoring and Analysis Instrument for Mine Environment
abstract: The environment in underground mine is very complicated, high levels of toxic gases pose a threat to the safety and health of workers. But the existing single-parameter gas detecting device has the disadvantages of high cost, large volume, and poor versatility. This paper designs a mine environment comprehensive monitoring and analysis instrument, which integrates various sensors to monitor carbon dioxide, nitrogen dioxide, oxygen, carbon monoxide, as well as particle matter, ambient temperature, humidity. At the same time, the instrument has variety of communication interfaces, enabling real-time data upload, local storage, and on-site display. The software design and hardware integration were completed, the actual test results were good and achieved the expected requirements.

articleTitle: Consensus of Discrete-time Multi-agent Systems with Decaying Multiplicative Uncertainties
abstract: The paper studies the consensus problem of discrete-time multi -agent systems (MASs) with decaying multiplicative uncertainties and bounded communication delays in switching networks. Under the assumption that the switching topology is uniformly rooted and the multiplicative uncertainty is exponentially (or polynomially) decaying, it is proved that by selecting a proper constant gain in the protocol, the consensus can be achieved exponentially (or polynomially) in the presence of any bounded communication delays. Numerical simulations are given to illustrate the obtained results.

articleTitle: The mutual control of Raman laser and vibration of micro-resonator by optomechanics
abstract: We present a hybrid Raman-optomechanics model for exploring the mutual control of Raman laser and the vibration mode of micro-resonator by optomechanics, in which the Raman laser is modelled as the interaction between the optical mode in the micro-resonator and the molecular vibration of the material. We observe on the one side that the sidebands of the mechanical vibration of the micro-resonator can be stimulated when the system is driven into the Raman-laser regime, while this mechanical sideband cannot be observed if the system is below the threshold of the Raman laser, i.e., the system is out of the Raman laser regime. On the other hand, we find that the Raman laser or even high-order Raman-laser sideband can be stimulated when the vibration mode of the micro-resonator is stimulated. It is also shown that the frequency of the Raman laser can be controlled by tuning the parameter of the mechanical mode of the resonator, such as the frequency or damping rate of the mechanical mode. Our study opens up new dimension of research such as the control of Raman laser by optomechanics and the control of the mechanical motion of the micro-resonator by optical modulation.

articleTitle: An Approach to 3D SLAM for a Mobile Robot in Unknown Indoor Environment towards Service Operation
abstract: In this paper, an approach of 3D SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is presented for mobile robot towards service operation. The scheme can be briefly concluded as follows. Firstly, various robust and stable point and line features are extracted from RGB images and their corresponding 3D information is obtained from the depth image as landmarks for robot localization. Secondly, considering the occlusion and segmentation errors of line features in RGB images, a class of optimal decision models are constructed with a kind of Huber kernel function of point errors and line errors so as to find the optimizing solutions of rotation matrix and translation vector for the pose estimation of service robot. Thirdly, a pose graph is generated as an effective reference for localization along with the selection of keyframes and loop closure based on a bag-of-words model. Moreover, the pose graph is optimized using bundle adjustment algorithm and the robot trajectory is also globally optimized to correct drift error and enhance the consistency of map. Along with the localization of robot, a 3D sparse map and a point cloud map is built simultaneously using the features in keyframes. A series of simulation experiments are carried out with public datasets to verify the performance advantages of our proposed approach.

articleTitle: Silicon Melt Liquid Level Detection Based on Parallel CRPF
abstract: To improve the performance of laser triangulation method for the silicon melt level detection, firstly, a voting mechanism based laser line coordinates calculation method is proposed in this paper. We take the vote according to the vertical coordinates of the laser spots, which are composed of the laser line affected by liquid surface fluctuation in the liquid level measurement image, to estimate the actual coordinate of the laser line. Secondly, A parallel cost-reference particle filter method is used to filter the coordinates, and a linear conversion is used to obtain the true value of the liquid level. Finally, the experimental results for the measurement data of the liquid level show that the proposed method can avoid the occurrence of impulse noise, and improve the robustness of the liquid level system effectively. Moreover, the proposed filter method is introduced to correct the liquid level measurement data.

articleTitle: Optimal Predictive Control for Three-Degree-of-Freedom Hypersonic Flutter Model
abstract: This paper presents an optimal predictive control method to suppress the hypersonic airfoil flutter and the airfoil flutter damage. Firstly, a three-degree-of-freedom (3DOF) airfoil flutter model is established and the airfoil flutter responses are analyzed in the Hopf bifurcation points. Subsequently, the optimal predictive control is employed to control the airfoil flutter by optimizing a cost function. In addition, the asymptotical stability of the airfoil flutter system is achieved. Then, several simulations are carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed flutter suppression problem for hypersonic flight vehicles.

articleTitle: A Musculoskeletal Model of Upper Limb for Disabled Extremity
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new musculoskeletal model (MSM) that can directly act on disabled extremities according to different stages of rehabilitation. Firstly, we build an upper limb MSM of health extremity. Then we calculate the torque generated by the health extremity, next considering the biological structure of the disabled extremity is the same as that of the health extremity, we use the principle of mirror image to mirror the torque generated by health extremity and the parameters of it to disabled extremity. Finally, according to physiology and Manual Muscle Test (MMT), we re-optimize the selected parameters in MSM to fit the real-condition of disabled extremity. The result exhibit that the MSM of disabled extremity is able to exhibit the ability of disabled extremity. In the next study, we will try to introduce it into rehabilitation robot control.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Home Security System Based on BP Neural Network Information Fusion
abstract: At present, the research of smart home security system has become one of the key research directions of smart home system. It is necessary to detect and judge the security of the home in real time through the system, so as to avoid the occurrence of unexpected disasters. This paper first studies and designs the overall scheme of security system in smart home. Then using the BP neural network information fusion to predict and analyze the safety system. Finally the predicted value compares with the expected value. The results show that the BP neural network information fusion can more accurately analyze the safety of smart home, which is conducive to further research and application of smart home security system.

articleTitle: Stabilization for Linear Tracking Systems Subject to Input Constraints with Reference Adjustment
abstract: A reference adjustment algorithm is investigated for linear systems with input constraints to guarantee the tracking mission in this paper. The attraction region of the reference is obtained based on the optimal low-and-high controller, for the case that the initial state does not within the attraction region, new references can be chosen by the proposed algorithm. By changing adequately, at each step, the reference to follow such that the tracking mission and the stability of the system can be guaranteed. Numerical simulation is given to show the validity of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A Gesture Recognition Device by Using FDC2214
abstract: A set of gesture recognition device is designed to realize simple gesture recognition in this paper, such as “1” - “5” and “stone”, “scissors”, “cloth” gesture determination and training. The system mainly consists of controller and the man-machine interface. The controller uses the STM32F407VGT6 micro controller with ARM Cortex-M4 kernel as the main control chip. The man-machine interface is mainly composed of FDC2214 sensor chip, OLED display screen and keypad. After detecting the value of external capacitance by two FDC2214 chips, the device obtains 8 sets of stable data through kalman filtering. The probability of each gesture is calculated by BP-neural network, and the result is finally displayed by OLED. The device can train the weights of BP-neural network by feedback, and ensure the correct rate of gesture recognition for different people. The device has the advantages of simple structure, high recognition accuracy, and learning and training.

articleTitle: Speed Sensorless Direct Torque Control of Direct-drive Permanent Magnet Wind Generator
abstract: Wind energy is an environmentally friendly energy source. In daily life, wind energy is mainly converted into electricity. Conventional wind power systems use induction motors, but induction motors have the characteristics of complex structure, strong coupling, and difficulty in maintenance. Therefore, this paper chooses direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous generator, and adopts speed sensorless control and direct torque control scheme. Through the analysis of the simulation results, the control method adopted in this paper greatly simplifies the control structure of the direct-drive permanent magnet generator and achieves better control results.

Author Keywords: Direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous wind turbine

articleTitle: A Fault Identification Method Based on Multiresolution Generalized S-Transform
abstract: In order to detect fault impulse feature of rotating machinery in operation of non-uniform rotation, a fault identification method based on multiresolution generalized S-transform (MGST) is proposed in this paper. In this method, generalized S-transform (GST) with different scales is employed to generate time-frequency spectrums for the fault vibration signal. Then, normalize these spectrums and calculate the shift factors, phase factors, frequency factors and scale factors of the maximum energy, thus, an impulse component with the maximum energy could be extracted. Repeat this iteration for several times, all the impulse components could be extracted, combining the rotating speed information and structural parameters, the fault could be identified. The simulation proves that the proposed method expresses fast decomposition speed and high precision.

articleTitle: Reduced-order estimator based linear quadratic robust tracking control of polytopic LPV systems by integrating preview action and integral regulation
abstract: A reduced-order state estimator based robust linear quadratic optimal tracking control policy is proposed for a class of polytopic linear parameter varying (LPV) systems in this paper. Compared with the existing works, the results of this paper have two main merits. Firstly, the constructed design method of reduced-order estimator can avoid the traditional requirement of system output decomposition. Thus the cases of LPV systems with unknown disturbance in output can be handled. From this respect, more wide application can be expected by our method. Secondly, by integrating state feedback, preview action, and integral regulation, a novel tracking control scheme for LPV systems is further proposed. In particular, the introduced preview action can improve the tracking accuracy significantly. Finally, the effectiveness of these conclusions are validated by a case study of cart-spring system.

articleTitle: Wireless Distributed Wearable Health Monitoring System
abstract: In this paper, through distributed design method, we design a wireless wearable system that can meet the demand of real-time monitoring of health data. The existing wearable instruments are usually in the hospital used by professional doctors or professional technicians. With a large number of connections, these complex and expensive devices are not convenient for real-time detection. This product combines the technology of wireless sensor and wearable systems, including research about wireless sensor nodes, wireless sensor network, and the measurement of temperature, oxygen saturation and motion state signal. This design uses the CC2538 chip, based on basic interfaces of Contiki, to realize the sensor class encapsulation of MLX90615, MAX30102 and LPB100. In addition, the APP on terminal equipment realize the data interaction with the center node. This system is in line with the characteristics of portable and dexterous wearable devices, and at the same time, it realizes the open modularization program mode, which is conducive to the expansion development. The terminal APP has the function of visual display of node data to achieve data exchange, realtime data visualization, historical data visualization and other purposes. This wireless distributed wearable system has the advantages of miniaturization, wireless, low cost, flexibility and easy to carry. It achieves the purpose of health monitoring and data collection and is suitable for the current market.

articleTitle: A Synchronous Tracking Error Suppression Method Based on Dynamic Error Coefficients
abstract: In modern industrial development and industrial manufacturing processes, the issue of synchronous control is an important research direction. How to make synchronized synchronization of the axes of the multi-axis system is a problem. This paper designs a suitable synchronous control structure based on the concept of dynamic error coefficient. The value of the dynamic error coefficient and the calculation of structure factor in the synchronous control structure are calculated and simulated to verify the effectiveness of the control method.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Electrolytic Cell State Based on Fuzzy Clustering
abstract: In the process of electrolytic aluminum, analysis of electrolytic cell's operation state is key to its optimization and control. To improve the accuracy of cell state evaluation, a method of comprehensive evaluation based on fuzzy clustering is proposed in this paper. First, the comprehensive index is defined, which reflects energy balance, material balance and stability. Then, the cell state evaluation model based on fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm is established to classify the cell states into three categories, including good, normal and poor. Finally, the cell state prediction model based on fuzzy neural network is designed to predict the cell state after 24 hours. The experimental results show that the proposed method can accurately evaluate the current cell state and predict the future cell state, which is of great significant to the stability, energy saving and consumption reducing of production.

articleTitle: DLIDX: A Double Level Index for Cloud Storage Environment
abstract: As data grows in amount, the researchers focus on the multiple condition query problem in cloud store data. The traditional index structures which are used in the relationship database. They have defects in maintenance and query efficiency in the cloud storage environment. This paper proposes a double level index framework(DLIDX). In DLIDX, the index of cloud storage is constructed by global index and local indexes. Each property of cloud data forms a dimension. For each dimension, the global index establishes the mapping relationship between the property and the node devices by inverting the hash table. The local indexes, a kind of bitmap index, are stored in the node devices. The bitmap indexes support local query of nodes. This framework can reduce the unnecessary retrieval cost. Meanwhile, the executive efficiency of the framework is less affected by the dataset. The experimental result proves that the performance of DLIDX is better than other methods.

articleTitle: A New Method of CT Imaging: TTBP
abstract: CT imaging technology plays an important role in the field of medical diagnosis. Filtered Back-Projection (FBP) algorithm is usually used for image reconstruction. However, there are some noise defects in the reconstructed image, and CT imaging requires higher accuracy of the image. In order to reduce these noise defects, use TT transform instead of Fourier filtering in FBP, and a TT back projection algorithm (TTBP) is proposed. Firstly, The image projection signal is transformed by TT. Then, using the TT transform spectral features of the diagonal elements, the noise signal of the projected signal is processed. Finally, back projection is used to reconstruct the original image. Using Shepp-Logan skull in medical CT imaging as a model and algorithm is implemented in MATLAB. Compared with the simulation results, the obtained image has better control of noise flaws, and the resulting image is clearer and smoother, which has a high application value.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Calculation of Gasoline Mixing Process in GDI Engine
abstract: Starting the first cycle of the first cycle of combustion in the idle start-stop technology is the key link. For the first cycle of the compression stroke, the self-ignition and misfire of the air-fuel mixture in the cylinder are easily caused. The FIRE software is used to establish the first-cycle first-cylinder oil and gas hybrid simulation calculation model. When the piston is at the position 60 before top dead center, different injection quantities, different in-cylinder flow fields, oil and gas mixing fields, and temperature fields are simulated and calculated. The optimal relationship between the fuel injection quantity and injection timing of the normal combustion of the first cylinder is given.

articleTitle: Chaotic Oscillation Control in Power System based on Adaptive Linear Feedback Sliding Mode Control
abstract: The power system is a typical complex nonlinear system. In some parameters, chaotic oscillation will be occurred in the power system. In this paper, a second-order power system is introduced and its chaotic dynamic behavior is analyzed. In order to suppress the chaotic oscillation of the power system, an adaptive linear feedback sliding mode controller is designed. Unlike the traditional sliding mode controller, the designed controller can estimate the disturbance of system via the adaptive control, so the upper bound of the disturbance does not need to be known. In addition, it also has good robustness. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and the good robustness of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Improved Droop Control for Suppressing Reactive Circulating Current and Proportionally Distributing Reactive Load between Parallel Converters
abstract: Converters are interface of the clean renewable energy integrated into Microgrid. These parallel converters usually adopt droop control for synchronization and load proportion distribution without communication. Due to mismatch between the system impedance (include converter output impedance and line impedance between converter and connecting point) ratio and capacity ratio of converters, a reactive circulating current is caused between converters and the reactive load can't be distributed by converters capacity ratio. The reactive circulating current and load distribution problem will lead to overvoltage and overload of small capacity converter and microgrid unstable. In order to overcome above problems, an improved droop control strategy based on virtual impedance is carried out by analyzing the reactive circulating current and reactive load distribution principle. The virtual impedance used in this strategy is optimal designed to make the system impedance ratio match the capacity ratio between parallel converters. The simulation results show that the goal of suppressing the reactive circulating current and proportionally distributing the reactive load is achieved.

articleTitle: A Method of Probability Transformation Based on the Assignable Certainty
abstract: To deal with the uncertainty problems by using Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory, the reliability values of the various propositions usually need to be transformed into the basic probabilities, which facilitates a correct decision-making. However, some probability transformation algorithms may not make full use of the prior information and bring about risks of the wrong decision due to the inaccurate probability transformation. Thus, this paper proposes an algorithm of the probability transformation based on the Assignable Certainty, in which different transformation rules are respectively presented to handle two cases of all existence/partial existence of single proposition. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is more objective and accelerates the convergence process. It not only improves the accuracy of decision-making, but also reduces the risk of decision-making.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Bayesian Multi-target Trackers
abstract: Bayesian multi-target tracking algorithms have attracted substantial interest in recent years for their theoreticalconsistency. While much attention has been devoted to the design of Bayesian multi-target trackers, little work has been presented for their performance evaluation. Since no explicit association between tracks and targets are made, the performance evaluation of Bayesian multi-target tracking algorithms is difficult. This paper presents a scheme for this purpose. An optimal assignment algorithm to associate the estimates with the truth is proposed. Based on the estimate-to-truth assignment, we adopt a robust method for the track-to-truth assignment. Finally, several measures of effectiveness (MoEs) on track level can be defined to take a closer look at different aspects of Bayesian multi-target tracking algorithms. Simulation results show the effectiveness of this evaluation scheme.

articleTitle: Cloud Server-Based Distributed Platoon Control for Intelligent Micro Vehicles
abstract: This study proposes an experimental platform of vehicular platoon for intelligence micro vehicle (IMV) distributed control based on cloud server. The experimental platform consists of three IMVs and the cloud server. IMV is developed independently, and it contains image sensor module, distance sensor module, wireless communication module and the module of vehicle. IMV forms a platoon by the distributed control mechanism on cloud server. The data is transmitted between IMV and cloud server by the wireless communication technique. The algorithm of the distributed platoon control is achieved on cloud server, and it calculates the desired velocity and gap of vehicles. Finally, the experiments are conducted. Results demonstrate the effectiveness with respect to the desired velocity and gap of platoon.

articleTitle: Observer Design for Information Diffusion in OSN Modeled by PDEs
abstract: The process of information diffusion through online social networks (OSNs) (e.g., Facebook, QQ, Twitter) gained much importance during the last few years because of its enhanced role on our lives from social interaction to socio-economic, security and health etc. In this paper a partial differential equation (PDEs) based observer is designed by backstepping approach to estimate the state of information diffusion through online social networks. The designed observer works on the proposed new concept of information diffusion influence factors, where the diffusion process of information through OSNs is not only depends on time but also on distance (friendship hops). The flow of information diffusion among different users is found to be cascade in nature with varying rate based on user to user interactions. The objective of this paper is to have a better understanding with the growth rate of information diffusion through OSNs.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimal Operation of Photovoltaic Genration with Cascade Small Hydropower Generation
abstract: Hydropower generation is the main renewable generation system as well as PV generation in china. The paper comprehensively considers the operational characteristics of the two renewable energy generations, and adds the PV power generation into the cascade small hydropower generation system to improve the energy complementarity in the power system. A mathematical model based on the coordination of the two generations is established in this paper, the objective of the model is to minimize the fluctuation of the residual load. The impact of the PV generation and cascade hydropower generation peaking capacity and short-term water regulation are discussed. Particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the coordination of the two generations and improve the searching efficiency. Simulation study results reveal that the coordination operation of cascade hydropower and PV generation can further increase the load smooth capacity. It also improves the intermittence and fluctuation of PV system and improves economic efficiency and ensuring the safe and stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Roll Eccentricity Repetitive Compensation Control Based on Sparse Fourier Transform for Cold Rolling Mill
abstract: The roll eccentricity is one of main factors affecting quality of strip products. In order to improve product quality of strip, the roll eccentricity compensation control was studied. Sparse fourier transform was introduced for detecting roll eccentricity information, which is a complex high frequency periodic signal. And then a composite control scheme based on PI control and repetitive control was proposed. The simulation result indicates that the method presented in this paper can detect frequency of roll eccentricity signal quickly and accurately. The structure of controller was simple and easy to implement, and had good tracking effect on roll eccentricity periodic signal, meet the requirements of roll eccentricity compensation.

articleTitle: An Operation Mode Optimization Method for Tobacco Loosening and Conditioning Process Based on Batch Clustering and KNN Algorithm
abstract: The stable control of the loosening and conditioning process is a prerequisite for the quality of the tobacco. However, in the current tobacco loosening and conditioning process, operating parameters are set based on long-term production experience. So, it is significant to optimize the operating mode of the loosening and conditioning process by finding the operating parameters that match the current state best from the excellent operation mode library. An optimization method of operation mode based on batch clustering and KNN algorithm is proposed in this paper. The entire optimization process includes loosening and conditioning, ordering and casing, and drying. Therefore, comparative experiments of subprocess optimization and whole process optimization are carried out in this study. The results of experiments and verifications of the agent model show that the water proportions optimized by two comparative experiments are more consistent with actual production than the previous one. Compared with the subprocess optimization, the optimization effect of the whole process is better, which is meaningful to actual production.

articleTitle: Boundary Artifacts Removal of Synthesis View by Pre-filtering the Texture Image in 3D Video
abstract: In 3D video systems, texture image of reference view may include blurred edges while the edges of depth image are often sharp. It induces artifacts in the generated synthesis view due to the inconsistency between the edges of the texture and depth images. We propose a new method to remove such boundary artifacts, which is achieved by pre-filtering the regions of the texture image near boundaries with the guidance of its associated depth image. Experiments show that the proposed method well removes the artifacts of the synthesis view.

articleTitle: On the Orbital Pursuit-Evasion Games with Low Constant Thrust-to-Mass Ratio
abstract: Much research has been done on the topic of pursuit-evasion games, which are of interest in diverse fields. Orbital pursuit-evasion game is more complex to some extent compared with other kinds of pursuit-evasion game due to the unique orbital dynamics and environment. Assuming a low constant thrust-to-mass ratio and that the thrust pointing direction is the only control option, this paper presents an efficient orbital pursuit-evasion model based on the relative state differential equations in LVLH (Local Vertical, Local Horizontal) coordinate system and a method to calculate the saddle equilibrium solution. Moreover, by analyzing the orbital pursuit-evasion model about the terminal condition and behavior learning framework, this paper reaches two useful and efficient conclusions, showing that the maneuver capability of the pursue spacecraft should be better than the evader spacecraft, or the role of each other will be exchanged, and the saddle equilibrium solution can't guarantee an optimal strategy in an imperfect information situation, and the behavior learning framework is an efficient way to handle that.

articleTitle: Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Preview Tracking Control of Linear Discrete-Time systems with unknown dynamics
abstract: In this paper., an off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm is presented to solve the optimal preview tracking control of discrete time systems with unknown dynamics. Firstly., an augmented state-space system that includes the available preview knowledge as a part of the state vector is constructed to cast the preview tracking control problem as a standard linear quadratic regulator (LQR) one. Secondly., the reinforcement learning technique is utilized to solve the algebraic Riccati equation (ARE) using online measurable data without requiring the a priori knowledge of the system matrices. Compared with the existing off-policy RL algorithm., the proposed scheme solves a preview tracking control problem. A numerical simulation example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Exponentially Passive Analysis of Switched Linear Systems with a Novel Storage Function
abstract: This paper studies the exponential passivity for switched linear systems. A novel storage function is used to derive the exponential passivity with an dissipative rate α. The whole running processes of subsystems are analysed instead of just analysing the activated interval by deploying a new storage function during the inactivated interval. With different energy supply rates for switched linear systems, we provide some different sufficient conditions to ensure different kinds of exponential passivity. Finally, numerical examples are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the main results.

articleTitle: A Fast Corner Detection Method from Laser Readings
abstract: A corner detection method is addressed in this paper. It is designed in order to construct a feature-based map which is applied to the simultaneous localization and mapping problem of mobile robots. With a iterative line segments extraction algorithm, the corner detection method has low time complexity and high accuracy. Results of experiment illustrate the effectiveness of the designed corner detection method.

articleTitle: Accurate Football Detection and Localization for Nao Robot with the Improved HOG-SVM Approach
abstract: Under the background of the RoboCup, this essay aims to solve the problem of finding and localizing the football in the limited computation hardware environment. Machine learning method has been used in the present study, for its much better robustness comparing with the traditional methods, such as template matching and contour detection. In this paper, we use hough circle transform for detection preliminarily. After this operation, only a few candidates will be left. Then we extract candidates' histogram of oriented gradient, using support vector machine (SVM) to predict if the candidate contains football. Relying on the successful detection, we construct a space model to retrieve the distance. In experiment section, the precision and recall were calculated on a test set, which indicates our method is accurate. Also, we compared the ground truth of distance with theoretical value, finding the error is negligible.

articleTitle: Design of DC Micro-grid Based on Bus Voltage Grading Control
abstract: Due to the intermittent nature of the distributed power supply in the microgrid and the indeterminate output power, real-time changes in system load can have an impact on the DC bus voltage. In order to solve these problems better, the DC microgrid bus voltage grading control strategy is designed. First, the system structure of the DC microgrid is constructed. In this paper, the bus voltage of the DC microgrid is hierarchically controlled and divided into four levels according to the bus voltage. According to the voltage level of each module and different working modes, the system is divided into five working states to ensure the DC bus voltage. Maintain system stability by reducing ripple. This paper determines the operating state of the energy storage module by detecting and comparing the load demand power and photovoltaic power generation, ie using the battery and the super capacitor as energy relaxation. The system ends to ensure the stability of the DC bus voltage. Finally, the simulation model based on MATLAB is used to verify the effectiveness of the control strategy. The simulation results show the effectiveness and correctness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Dynamics Analysis of a Discrete Variable Structure Controller for Uncertain Systems
abstract: In this paper, dynamics of a sliding mode controller (SMC) designed for the discrete uncertain system is studied. The proposed SMC is derived based on a non-smooth reaching law without a disturbance observer. Dynamics analysis of the controller focuses on system behaviors both outside and within the quasi-sliding mode domain (QSMD). Numerical results are provided to demonstrate performance of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Nonlinear System Identification of CZ Silicon Crystal Growth between Pulling Speed and Diameter
abstract: A nonlinear structure and parameter identification method is proposed to get the nonlinear dynamic model of Czochralski silicon crystal growth between pulling speed and diameter. The mean impact value(MIV) is used to select the historical speed and historical diameter input terms that significantly affect the crystal diameter. The nonlinear input combination terms are determined by the simultaneous estimation method. The model parameters are identified by the least square algorithm. The enhanced correlation-testing method is used to test the identified model. The simulation result shows that the proposed method can effectively solve the identification problem of nonlinear structure and parameter when the prior knowledge of relationship between pulling speed and crystal diameter is lacking.

articleTitle: Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulation Applied to AUV Control
abstract: This paper introduces a hardware-in-the-Ioop (HIL) system to simulate plug and play controllers for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). The HIL system is a real-time simulator composed of two parts: a model-based virtual plant and an embedded controller. As HIL system does not require the design of physical systems, therefore, it can reduce the control design cost. In this paper, controller and model are both implemented using Mission Oriented Operating Suite-Interval Programming (MOOS-IvP) software. At first, the AUV mathematical model is obtained by dynamic and hydrodynamic analyses. Then, a robust controller is designed considering the uncertainties and nonlinearities. The robust controller is implemented on a Raspberry Pi microcomputer, while the virtual plant is simulated on a computer. Finally, MOOS-IvP based HIL simulations are compared to MATLAB simulations.

articleTitle: A Method of Calibration and Measuring Foeal Length for Pan-Tilt-Zoom Camera
abstract: In view of the installed Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera, a calibration method is proposed in this paper. Unlike other calibration methods, we consider that simple distortion models cannot describe the distortion of non-axisymmetric lenses. To solve this problem, we use a distortion matrix to describe the distortions of different parts of the lens under non-axisymmetric conditions. The camera intrinsic parameters and distortion matrix are then determined at discrete steps in a monotonically increasing zoom sequence that spans the full zoom range of the camera. Finally, we briefly discuss how this can be used to estimate intrinsic parameters and distortion matrix of the image captured within the camera's full range of pan tilt and zoom configurations.

articleTitle: Circuit Design and Physical Experiment of Time Synchronization for WSNs
abstract: The LSTS algorithm is a kind of time synchronization algorithm which is directed to suppress the random bounded communication delay in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), Theoretical analysis shows that even under random delays, the drift estimations of all sensors given by this algorithm are asymptotically convergent to a common constant in a rate of 1/k, where k is the discrete time, and the global synchronization error is bounded. In order to further verify the validity of the theoretical results and the practical feasibility of the LSTS algorithm, we autonomously design a hardware platform, and conduct physical experiments on this platform by comparing LSTS algorithm with some other algorithms like ATS and WMTS in several aspects including the convergent rate, the offset compensation error and the synchronization error. The result suggests that the LSTS algorithm is state of the art in most performance indices. Finally, the method of “synchronous second pulse(SSP) + synchronization time(ST)” is designed to provide timing service for WSNs, which makes the timing protocol very simple, and it's also convenient for the time acquisition for the underlying hardware, thus enhances the practicability and versatility.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Using Pearson Correlation and HOG with Single Training Image Per Person
abstract: Face recognition with training single sample per person (SSPP) is a full of challenging task because in such a scene it is difficult to predict the face correct only by seeing some one one time. Considering the fact that different portions of human faces have different information to face recognition, we use histograms of oriented gradients (HOG) algorithm to compute the features based on framework of face matrix and use Pearson correlation to classify these features with SSPP. HOG extracts the most framework information both training sample and testing sample, Pearson correlation detects the same information between them. This method which includes HOG and Pearson correlation makes well difference in variation representation, showing a good performance in face recognition with SSPP.

articleTitle: A Super Capacitor Charging Device Based on the Sliding Mode Control Strategy
abstract: In this paper, a sliding mode control strategy is proposed for the tram with supercapacitor to deal with the problems, such as the large output current fluctuation and the pool system robustness. Based on the average state model of the DC-DC converter and supercapacitor characteristics, a dynamic model of the charging system for the tram with supercapacitor energy storage is established. By selecting the appropriate sliding surface and Lyapunov function, the duty cycle output rule is determined to satisfy the system stability requirements. According to the requirements of the device, controllers are designed for the constant current charging mode and constant power charging mode respectively. The simulation experimental results show that the charging system adopting the method proposed in this paper can reach the steady state quickly. The current fluctuation and system disturbance can be suppressed effectively, which can increase the system stability and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Algorithm Using Shallow Residual Network for Individual Soldier System
abstract: Facial expression recognition plays an increasingly important role in monitoring the mental state of individual soldiers. Aiming at the problem of low accuracy rate by traditional facial expression recognition method, this paper proposes an improved shallow residual network facial expression recognition algorithm. Based on ResNet which is the main target detection framework of existing deep learning, a Res-HyperNet structure is proposed to learn more shallow features. First, the shallow features are aggregated and compressed into one space. To improve the recognition effect, this paper sent the high-level features which have more useful semantic information to a deeper convolution layer through a shortcut to perform fusion calculation. Three public datasets (CK+, JAFFE, Oulu-CASIA) and self-made datasets are used for accuracy rate experiments. Compared with the existing mainstream facial expression recognition method, the improved shallow residual network algorithm can raise the accuracy rate up to 3%.

articleTitle: A Decision Fusion Model for 3D Detection of Autonomous Driving
abstract: This paper proposes a multimodal fusion model for 3D car detection inputting both point clouds and RGB images and generates the corresponding 3D bounding boxes. Our model is composed of two subnetworks: one is point-based method and another is multi-view based method, which is then combined by a decision fusion model. This decision model can absorb the advantages of these two sub-networks and restrict their shortcomings effectively. Experiments on the KITTI 3D car detection benchmark show that our work can achieve state of the art performance.

articleTitle: Transmitter Current Tracking Method of Improving Power-Transfer Efficiency for Two-Coil Wireless Power Transfer System
abstract: Starting from a brief overview of two-coil wireless power transfer (WPT) system, a transmitter current tracking method is realized to improve the power-transfer efficiency of the system. The fixed-load receiver is allowed to be moved to nearly any position within the system's working range, and the system still achieves a near maximum power-transfer efficiency. The simulation results show that the proposed method can be used to improve the WPT system's efficiency more rapidly and more accurately.

articleTitle: Crowd Extrusion Modeling and Simulation
abstract: The commonly used social force model can well describe some typical phenomena in crowd simulation, but it is a kind of virtual force rather than the real one, so it cannot describe the behaviors of crowd when a collision occurs in scene of high density crowd. In this paper, a crowd extrusion model is proposed based on the momentum theorem and motion mechanics of human body. In each step of simulation, the minimum avoidance distance is calculated. The collision between those whose current distance is less than the minimum avoidance distance is possibly unavoidable, and then the actual force that the pedestrians experienced is calculated. On the other hand, the movement of other pedestrians still follows the social force. The simulation results show that this improved model is more close to the actual scenarios of high density crowd.

articleTitle: Neural network- fuzzy adaptive PID controller based on VIENNA rectifier
abstract: After establishing the Vienna rectifier mathematical model, we set the PID parameters through the intelligent algorithm to overcome the poor effect of the traditional voltage and current double closed loop PI controller when it encountered disturbance. In this paper, the single neuron adaptive PID controller is used to control the DC side voltage so that the output voltage can suppress the disturbance. The current inner loop uses a fuzzy-PI controller to control the current component in the dq coordinate system so that the current can quickly respond to disturbance when the load is disturbed and track the voltage of the grid.

articleTitle: A Parallel Multi-swarm Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based on CUDA Streams
abstract: Since the Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) has been proposed, some swarm intelligence algorithms were migrated to the GPU. The release of the Fermi architecture allows NVIDIA's GPUs to use CUDA streams to launch multiple kernel functions simultaneously. Many forms of particle swarm optimization algorithms for CUDA without streams were proposed. In this paper, in order to further utilize GPU performance, we propose a method of applying the multi-swarm particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) on CUDA streams. Aiming to further enhance the search ability of PSO, the multi-start local search algorithm was applied to multi-swarm PSO. The experimental results show that the algorithm has better performance.

articleTitle: A Robust Background Initialization Method Based on Stable Image Patches
abstract: The estimation of the stationary background from the video sequence is a challenging problem in Computer Vision. The process can be easily affected by illumination changes in the video sequence and estimate inaccurate background image. To solve this problem, this paper improved the Labgen, the best performance method in the SBMC2016, and proposed a robust background initialization method based on the stable image patches. This method can generate accurate background image when the given video sequence has strong illumination changes, and this method also has strong robustness. First, the most stable illumination condition sequence is selected for the next background modeling. Then each frame of video is divided into patches of the appropriate size. Select the most stable image patches by frame-by-frame comparison over the entire video sequence; and use the temporal median filter for the subset of selected patches to generate background image. The experimental results on the SBMnet dataset show that the proposed method can generate accurate background image, and perform better compared with the latest method when the video sequence has strong illumination changes.

articleTitle: Exploration research of thinking innovation based on PCST theory and knowledge graph
abstract: Thinking innovation is one of important driving forces to promote scientific and technological progress. Information technology can help humans to brainstorm as many potential ideas and methods as possible for given problems so as to inspire their creative thinking. Knowledge graph provides a structural method to storage human prior knowledge described by concepts and relationships between them in a graph way. The frame and models of Probability Construction Space Theory(PCST) explained the mechanism of human creative thinking and procedure of new ideas generation. Our research work explores generation of new potential methods of detecting and perception geophysical information through simulating the creative thinking of new ideas of aircraft guidance based on the combination of theory and technology of knowledge graph and PCST. One experiment software system has been built to verify feasibility of this novel cognitive model and simulation method presented in our research work.

articleTitle: BRB fault diagnosis model based on fault tree analysis
abstract: Belief rule base was widely studied as a common expert system. However, due to the uncertainty of expert knowledge, the constructed rules cannot represent the relationship between model inputs and outputs accurately in a complex system. In this paper, a BRB model based on fault tree analysis is proposed. A case study in relay shows that it has a good performance in fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Intelligent Penetration of UAV Based on Moth Suppression Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the large number of planning constraints faced by UAV's in low-altitude penetration, ambiguity and strong coupling among various factors, an intelligent UAV penetration algorithm based on moth fire suppression optimization algorithm is proposed. MFO algorithm is a novel swarm intelligence optimization algorithm. The main inspiration of this algorithm comes from the flying mode of the moth, which is called lateral positioning in nature. As a new bionic swarm intelligence optimization algorithm, the algorithm analyzes the biological principle of the moth fire suppression optimization algorithm, establishes a mathematical model for the algorithm implementation process, and simulates the algorithm through typical function optimization. The simulation experiment and comparative analysis show that the moth fire suppression optimization algorithm can reduce the overall voyage cost of the UAV's low-altitude penetration path planning, and the calculation speed is faster, besides, the stability and effectiveness can be guaranteed, which could effectively avoid the threat source and perform the low-altitude penetration of UAV.

articleTitle: Design of Distance Education Authentication System Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Netework
abstract: With the large-scale development of distance education and remote examination, the research on remote login authentication system has received more and more attention, but the traditional face recognition, such as face recognition based on geometric features, recognizes the effect when the head deflection angle or face occlusion area is large. Unsatisfactory, not suitable for the environment where the user's head and posture changes and the face is decorated. Therefore, this paper designs a face recognition system based on deep convolutional neural network and builds a real-time face recognition platform. The face detection part adopts a cascade structure of lab classifiers adapted to different head poses. Feature localization adopts a strategy of stepwise optimization of face alignment results following face image resolution. The feature extractor is composed of convolutional neural network model. Alexnet improved. The experimental results show that the remote authentication system designed in this paper can effectively identify faces that are partially obscured by various angles and faces.

articleTitle: KPCA- KELM Ensemble based Incipient Fault Diagnosis Approach of Analog Circuits
abstract: An ensemble approach based on kernel principal component analysis and kernelized extreme learning machine, called KPCA - KELM, is proposed in this paper to deal with the incipient analog circuits diagnosis problem of insufficient generalization performance, too much training time and low fault recognition rate. Firstly, we set the single and multiple fault value of the circuit under test (CUT) and collect output response signal by frequency sweeping. Then, kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) is used for preprocessing the output characteristic data, obtaining the data dimension reduction of the corresponding CUT response signals, reducing system operating costs and leading the minimum loss of information. Finally, we use KELM for training and forecast, and add contrast experiment by the original extreme learning machine (ELM). The results verify the positioning ability of component fault diagnosis for CUT is effective.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Adaptive PID Control of Biomass Circulating Fluidized Bed Boiler
abstract: Biomass fuel havee advantages of low pollution and renewability, and biomass circulating fluidized bed has advantages of strong fuel adaptability, strong load regulation ability and low cost, so biomass circulating fluidized bed has attracted wide attention. However, the thermal process of biomass circulating fluidized bed's combustion system has characteristics of large inertia, large delay, non-linearity and strong coupling. It is difficult to achieve good control effect by using conventional PID control. Therefore, a fuzzy adaptive PID controller based on decoupling principle is adopted to improve the control performance of biomass circulating fluidized bed under load variation. The simulation result of Matlab/Simulink shows that the controller can realize the decoupling between the boiler bed temperature and the main steam pressure during the combustion process, and the anti-interference ability and stability of the bed temperature and the main steam pressure loop control are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Signal Processing Methods for Induction Loop-Cable Position and Speed Detection System
abstract: The mid-speed maglev train adopts synchronous traction. Only the real-time acquisition of the position and speed information of the train can realize the closed-loop traction of the train. The signal processing of the position and speed detection unit of the train is directly related to the accuracy of the position and speed information. The comparison and analysis of three kinds of signal processing methods, such as amplitude extraction method based on envelope detection, phase extraction method based on XOR comparison and position information extraction method based on synchronous demodulation, show that the signal processing based on synchronous demodulation has obvious advantages. This paper proposes synchronous demodulation based on phase-locked loop. The demodulation method proves that synchronous demodulation based on phase-locked loop method can simultaneously demodulate both the amplitude and phase information in the signal, and can effectively suppress the influence of the traction traveling wave, and has strong noise reduction capability.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Grid-Connected Control System of DFIG with Uncertain Parameter
abstract: A parameter-indetermined doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) grid-connected control strategy is proposed. This strategy does not rely on accurate parameters for control compensation. Firstly, grid voltage and stator voltage are respectively oriented during grid connection control process. Applying constant voltage control to obtain compensation term of power decoupling control. Secondly, q-axis voltage error signal based on grid voltage orientation is used to correct stator voltage phase error caused by installation position of speed encoder. Finally, the effectiveness of grid-connected control strategy with uncertain parameter DFIG is verified by constructing a DFIG grid-connected experimental platform.

articleTitle: Research on State Acquisition for Electric Arc Furnace Under Multivariate Combination Model
abstract: As a highly non-linear and unbalanced load, the electric arc furnace brings great pressure to the harmonic management of grid. Different harmonic characteristics in different operating conditions also increase the difficulty of governance. How to build a simulation model to represent the electrical characteristics of AC arc furnace in different periods has become the focus on current research. In this paper, the time-varying resistance of AC arc furnace is derived the energy balance relation and overlaid with the classical non-linear resistance model. Also, the model of arc length with random variation is added innovatively, a new non-linear time-varying resistance mode is formed. By using MATLAB/simulink software, the voltage current and volt-ampere characteristic, harmonic characteristic during melting and refining are simulated. The simulation results conform to the dynamic characteristics of general arc furnace under different working conditions, so the validity and applicability of model is verified.

articleTitle: Safe semi-supervised learning from risky labeled and unlabeled samples
abstract: In machine learning community, Safe Semi-Supervised Learning (S3L) has received the growing concerns. A few S3L methods are proposed to safely exploit risky unlabeled samples which may lead to performance degeneration of Semi-Supervised Learning (SSL). However, these methods have the following drawbacks: (1) The risk of unlabeled samples are artificially determined by analyzing different characteristics between SSL and Supervised Learning (SL); (2) They do not consider the negative impact of labeled samples. In this paper, we present ℓ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-norm based S3L which can safely exploit the risky labeled and unlabeled samples. In our algorithm, we employ ℓ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-norm based loss function to build an optimization problem for S3L. For the purpose of solving the ℓ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> -norm optimization problem, we introduce an effective iterative optimization strategy. In the iterative process, the samples' weights (including labeled and unlabeled ones) which can reflect the corresponding risk degrees are adaptively estimated. Therefore, it is expected to simultaneously reduce the negative effect of both labeled and unlabeled samples. Finally, we carry out the experiments on benchmark datasets and our algorithm can yield the desired learning performance.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Based on Semantic Patches
abstract: Recently, facial landmark detection has been well studied. Carrying on with these researches, we propose a semantic-patches-based framework in facial expression recognition (FER), which utilizes the information captured in facial vital senses. Firstly, the semantic patches centered on face landmarks are extracted. Then both Dense SIFT and corrected-Uniform Circle Local Binary Patterns (c-UCLBP) features are extracted and combined together. In addition, shape features denoting the relationships of facial components also extracted as a supplement. According to the proposed algorithm framework, we obtained good experimental results, and the accuracy on CK+ database and JAFFE database is 97% and 95% respectively.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a new type of Intelligent Automatic Parking Lock
abstract: In this paper, a new type of intelligent parking lock is designed, including parking lock base, silica gel column, control module, motor drive module, Bluetooth communication module, and power module. The silica gel column is connected to the base of the parking lock by the motor driving module, which can realize the rotation of 0 degrees to 90 degrees. The soft material of the silica gel column, the control module, the motor drive module, the Bluetooth communication module and the power supply module are arranged in the base of the parking lock. This paper relates to the intelligent parking lock has the advantages of high safety, simple structure, high degree of automation, good stability, but also has a mobile phone remote control parking lock column automatic lifting and soft material into imitation function, can be widely used in residential, shopping malls, schools, companies, fixed parking installation.

articleTitle: UAV Elasticity Formation Extension Consensus Control based on Joint Errors
abstract: To solve the problem of the lack communication for UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) formation control, this paper proposed a control method for formation based on the joint errors. This method is essentially an extension of the consensus control theory. Based on the position of the UAV, an elastic look-ahead point is set. By using the position and velocity errors of each UAV, a linear state equation with the joint errors is established. The error feedbacks between other UAV s in the formation are introduced and an elasticity extension consensus controller is designed. The classic consistency controller is a special case for the extended consensus control in the case of some errors unknown. The stability of the system is verified by the Hurwitz stability analysis method. The conclusion is shown that if the system is stable, not only should there be a directed spanning tree, its elastic distance should also be a positive real number. The simulations show that when the nodes lose some communications, with the extensional controller the system can not only maintain a stable formation, but also the elasticity formation can adapt to the speed change of the leader.

articleTitle: 3D Perception and Reconstruction System Based on 2D Laser Scanner
abstract: 3D perception and reconstruction is an important research in the field of robot motion control and 3D manufacturing. A system for surface perception and reconstruction of the 3D area based on 2D laser scanner is outlined in this paper.
