Firstly, aiming at the limited work area of a single device, the “S-shaped” control strategy for scanning device is proposed to extend the effective operating range of the detection system so that the surface could be completely measured, analyzed and processed. The scanning point cloud could be registered to obtain a complete three-dimensional point cloud image. Secondly, due to the problem of the impulse noise, a weighted median filter based on the Euclidean distance is proposed to recover the correct depth information. The performance of the proposed system shows that the designed Euclidean distance-based median filtering method effectively removes impulse noise and preserves original depth information. The system can accurately get the 3D point cloud information, effectively process the scan data, and realize 3D perception and reconstruction for object.

articleTitle: Decentralized Estimation of Distribution Algorithms for Large Scale Networked Systems
abstract: In order to solve optimization problems in large scale networked systems, this paper proposes a method to implement estimation of distribution algorithms (EDA) in a decentralized way. The main point of decentralized EDA is that each subsystem solves its own optimization problems based on local and its neighbors' information. Numerical examples illustrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Exergy Lose in Dual Energy Conversion of Power to Gas (PtG) and Gas to Power (GtP)
abstract: In recent years, China is faced with the serious problem of abandoning wind and abandoning light on one hand, and the shortage of natural gas on the other hand. In this paper, a natural gas-based solution is proposed, that is, energy and natural gas energy can be reversed by using natural gas manufacturing technology and natural gas power generation technology, so as to achieve complementarity and economy of different end users. As part of feasibility demonstration, this paper analyzed the technology and comprehensive energy efficiency, and analyzed the combination of energy quality and efficiency by means of exergy analysis. This provides more support for the use of PtG technology.

articleTitle: Cross-coupled iterative learning contour compensation for high speed motion based on modified reference input
abstract: This paper focuses on the control of the contour error of the two axes servo motion control system. In order to improve the accuracy of the system under high speed motion, a series of cross coupled iterative learning Contour error compensation algorithm is proposed, and the estimation model of contour error and the precondition of the application of the verification algorithm-platform repeatability are presented. Verification compensation algorithm is better than iterative learning or contour control. Experiments show that the algorithm can effectively reduce the contour error of the system and improve the control accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Sampled-Data Control With Space-Varying Gain for Linear Distributed Parameter Systems
abstract: This paper introduces a sampled-data control (SDC) with space-varying gain for linear distributed parameter systems (DPSs) described by parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs). A SDC design with space-varying gain is developed in the formulation of space-dependent linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) by using an appropriate Lyapunov functional, which can stabilize exponentially the DPSs. Finally, a numerical example is offered to support the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Design of Nonlinear Unknown Input Observers and Its Application in Automobile Airbag Production Line
abstract: Aiming at the state estimation problem of a class of nonlinear systems, a method of Unknown Input Observers which complies with a robust sliding mode control law and an adaptation law is designed in this paper considering that the time delay that may lead to the instability of the system performance is inevitable in the process of modern networked control. Then the convergence of the designed observer is verified by Lyapunov stability criterion. Finally, the observer is applied to realize the estimation of the roll diameter and tension of the bagging station of the automobile airbag production line. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Output Feedback Control for Flexible-Joint Systems Under Time-Varying Disturbances
abstract: The paper studies the trajectory tracking problem of flexible-joint systems under time-varying disturbances. A novel finite-time observer based control methodology is proposed for systems, which is targeted to improve the tracking performance and reduce the effect of the disturbances on the systems. The design mainly consists of a finite-time observer and a finite-time output feedback controller. The finite-time observer is used to estimate unknown time-varying disturbances, higher-order derivatives of the disturbances and unmeasurable states in finite time. The finite-time output feedback controller realizes the closed-loop control in finite-time by using the estimates of the unmeasurable states and unknown time-vary disturbances from the finite-time observer. Compared with the conventional generalized proportional integral observer based control scheme, test results under two different conditions are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on Mid-Long Term Forecasting Method of Power Supply Based on Grey Model and Markov Forecasting Model
abstract: In the view of electricity consumption pattern fuzziness, effected by various factors such as socioeconomic structure and climate change, a new system can be presented for these uncertainties, called gray system. At last, GM (1,1) gray model can be used for fitting and to predict the long-term and medium-term power consumption forecasting. With the popularity of electricity consumption and the complexity of power system, the traditional gray model is not enough to satisfy the accuracy of the prediction. Besides, because of the certain regularity in monthly network power, Markov transfer probability can be used as the weight to carry out the weighted calculation. To predict the volatile data, in this paper, a gray GM (1,1) Markov prediction method is presented, which can effectively compensate for the limitation of the two methods in data fluctuation and improve the precision in short-time power data. In the end, after building the model, simulations show that the gray GM (1,1) Markov prediction model effectively fits the change tendency of the consumption and greatly improve the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Medical image enhancement method based on visual attention mechanism
abstract: A medical image enhancement method based on visual attention mechanism is proposed in view of the characteristics of low contrast and fuzzy medical image. First, this method uses visual attention computing model, analyzes the image significance, and obtains the global saliency map. Second, the global saliency map is divided into a number of subregions, and the average significant value of each subregion is obtained. Third, the weighted statistical coefficient of each area is obtained, the weighted coefficients of each block are multiplied by the statistics of the corresponding region pixels, that is, a histogram that reflects the size of the image information has been formed. Last, the dynamic range of the gray level is adjusted by the visual shielding effect and the principle of histogram equalization, the image enhancement is completed. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the algorithm has good enhancement effect on medical images, and can highlight the target area of images and maintain smooth areas.

Author Keywords: histogram that reflects the image information

articleTitle: Satellite Attitude Control Based on Backstepping Adaptive Sliding-Mode Method
abstract: A backstepping adaptive sliding-mode attitude control method was proposed for a three-axis stabilized satellite attitude control system with uncertain external disturbances. This method combined backstepping control with sliding-mode control, and used adaptive algorithm to estimate the external disturbances, so that, the external disturbances was suppressed. Lyapunov stability analysis showed that the closed-loop system was proved to be theoretically stable. The simulation results show that the controller can effectively deal with the influence of external disturbance in attitude control, and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Frequency Regulation Capability of Wind Power Considering its Uncertainty
abstract: The uncertainty of wind power is an important factor that affects its rapid development. This uncertainty causes the reserves it provides to the system through derating are also uncertain. Uncertain reserve support will affect the effect of frequency regulation. This paper estimates the reserve support provided by wind power from the perspective of wind power probability distribution, and evaluates the reserve capacity of the system when considering the uncertainty of wind power. In addition, from the perspective of making full use of wind energy, this paper points out that wind farms provide reserves through abandoning the wind in a non-periodic manner. By accurately assessing its frequency regulation capability, wind power can participate in system frequency regulation more effectively.

articleTitle: Container Terminal Logistics Computation Performance Evaluation with Great Principles of Computing and Case Study
abstract: Container terminal logistics systems (CTLS) are the typical complex logistics hubs whose operations are provided with the high nonlinearity and coupling. With the conceptual framework of computational logistics, the container logistics computation automation comprehensive perspective (CLC-ACP) is proposed based on great principles of computing (GPC). Subsequently, for a specific container terminal logistics case, we launch the logistics computation abstraction automation analysis and performance evaluation. The task latency of a job and job cluster are the focuses of attention. From the case study, we conclude that CLC-ACP can guide the design and evaluation of CTLS well, and then the agile, efficient and robust decision support model and design implement paradigm are supposed to obtain consequently.

articleTitle: Gain-Scheduling PI Controller using JITL and BPNN for PMSM Speed Drive System
abstract: For the sake of realizing the high-peformance permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) speed drive system, an improved gain-scheduling proportional-integral (PI) control scheme is proposed in this paper. First, to obtain the accute Jacobian information, a low-cost just-in-time learning (JITL) method is used to estimate the controlled model parameters of PMSM speed drive system, considering the nonlinearity and parameter uncertainties. Then, based on the on-line identification result for Jacobian information, the corresponding back propagetion neural network (BPNN) method is employed to supply the PI controller with the suitable parameters. The whole system stability including the above JITL and BPNN methods is analyzed based on the Lyapunov method. Finally, experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Simulation for multi-valued systems
abstract: In this paper, compared to current hot spots of simulations in others uncertain systems and combine with De Morgen algebras, we propose a series of concepts of multi-valued simulations. Meanwhile, we discuss some properties of multivalued simulations and prove relevant theorems and lemmas. Finally, we introduce the related notions of multi-valued simulations quotient.

articleTitle: An Image Denoising Algorithm based on Kuwahara Filter
abstract: In order to improve the readability of digital image, the image denoising algorithm is studied. The algorithm is performed using a combination of Kuwahara filter and non-subsampling Shearlets transform (NSST). Firstly, the image with noise is decomposed in multiple scales and in multiple directions by NSST, that is, the low frequency coefficients and high frequency coefficients are obtained, and then the threshold is processed to remove most of the noise effectively. Then, the filtered coefficient is transformed into NSST inverse transformation, and the denoising image 1 is obtained. Finally, the de-noising image 1 is filtered by the Kuwahara filter, and the final de-noising image is obtained. While de-noising, the Kuwahara filter can well retain the edge, contour and other details of the image. Through experimental simulation, this algorithm has the advantage of image denoising and can get high quality image denoising. By comparing objective evaluation indexes, this method is effective for image denoising.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Isolation Based on MM- ICA with Application to High-speed Railway
abstract: In this paper, a new fault detection and isolation scheme based on multiple models independent component analysis (MM-ICA) is established for high-speed railway. The proposed method firstly uses independent component analysis (ICA) to extract the essential independent components (ICs). Then a novel idea, which is to construct multiple ICA models, is proposed to locate fault. The proposed method is applied to fault detection and identification in both a simple multivariate system and highspeed railway motor, and the results are compared with principal components analysis (PCA). The simulation results clearly show the power and advantages of the novel fault detection and identification method based on MM-ICA.

articleTitle: Adaptive Constrained Control of Vibrating Flexible Marine Riser Systems
abstract: In this study, we consider the adaptive constrained control of vibrating flexible marine riser systems in the presence of input nonlinear saturation and system uncertainties. To realize the vibration suppression, input nonlinear saturation effects elimination and system uncertainties compensation, the boundary robust adaptive control is constructed by integrating the auxiliary system with online updating laws. Under the presented controller, the controlled system is analyzed and demonstrated to be uniformly bounded stable. Finally, simulation results demonstrate theoretical derivation.

articleTitle: A New Representation for Data: Sparse and Low-Rank
abstract: Recently, the sparse coding method has been successfully applied in the low-rank subspace clustering algorithm. In these methods, the image is represented as a low-rank linear combination of the atoms of the sparse dictionary, and the coefficient matrix is used to compute the similarity matrix for spectral clustering. However, the low-rank representation obtained by the subspace clustering may not be enough to describe the data structure. In this paper, we propose a new model by combining sparse coding and low-rank subspace clustering in the objective function simultaneously. The new model seeks for solutions which have sparse representation and low-rank representation as close as possible. In this case, the new representation obtained by our method is both sparse and low-rank. An efficient iteratively algorithm is also proposed to solve this model. Extensive experiments on several databases demonstrate that our method performs better than state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Fault Type Detection Based on Model Fusion
abstract: In order to further improve the accuracy of power transformer fault type detection, a model fusion transformer fault type detection method based on Self-organizing Map-Local Outlier Factor-Isolation ForestSelf (SOM-LOF-iForest) is proposed. First, according to the fault gas concentration data, SOM algorithm, LOF algorithm, and iForest algorithm are used to detect the fault type, and then use Analytic Hierarchy Process to fuse and improve the decision weight values of the SOM algorithm, LOF algorithm, and iForest algorithm to establish the model fusion and to get a new model of fault decision making. The results show that model fusion method overcomes the problem of the diagnostic accuracy of a single model in a certain aspect, and has the advantage of high detection accuracy compared to the existing power transformer fault type detection method.

articleTitle: Research on short term load forecasting model based on Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System
abstract: A short-term load forecasting model based on adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and descending step-length Drosophila algorithm-singular regression neural network (SFOA-GRNN) was constructed, and the model was trained and tested by historical load data. Through MATLAB simulation comparison, it can be clearly seen that SFOA-GRNN can predict short-term power load more efficiently than ANFIS. The SFOA-GRNN model has great advantages in terms of convergence time and prediction accuracy compared to the ANFIS model. The SFOA-GRNN model has excellent performance and stability, and can meet the requirements of short-term power load forecasting.

articleTitle: PSO-ABA Hybrid Algorithm for Balancing Wind Power Fluctuations by Energy Storage System
abstract: The optimization method of the energy storage device for the active output power of the wind farm is investigated to reduce the impact of wind farm output power fluctuation on the power grid. After establishing the standard deviation model about the charging and discharging power of the energy storage device, a new algorithm which is defined as PSO-ABA Hybrid Algorithm is proposed. And the feasibility of the algorithm is verified by several functions, such as Ackley function. In addition, the advantages and disadvantages are summarized. Then the optimal charging and discharging power of the energy storage device is obtained through the actual output power data of wind farm and grid power demand. Thereby, the problem of energy storage device stabilizing the output power fluctuations of wind farm is solved.

articleTitle: Development and Evaluation of a Portable Fuel Cell Hybrid System
abstract: In this paper, a fuel cell/lithium battery hybrid system for portable applications is developed, the system includes a polymer electrolyte membrane fuel cell stack, two hydrogen canisters, a lithium battery, a DC/DC converter cascaded to fuel cell and control electronic subsystem. The hardware circuit is designed for the system and the software program is written to realize the energy management of the hybrid power system, keeping the fuel cell in a good working condition under the precondition of satisfying the load power demand. The dynamic and static characteristics of the system are tested, and the tests show that the hybrid system allows the output of fuel cell to be buffered when handles sudden load changes. Energy management strategy can increase life span of the fuel cell because it avoids the counter-polarization of fuel cell during load mutation.

articleTitle: The Software Design of Modular Instrument Based on Proxy Pattern
abstract: Modular instrument has the advantages of small volume, low cost, and strong flexibility. It has been widely used in testing systems and testing instruments. In the design of the traditional modular instrument software, the function of each module calls from the top layer to the underlying hardware to read and write between different interfaces, including the external application interface, the command parsing interface, and the hardware reading and writing interface. To increase or decrease the module function, it is necessary to re edit the contents of the above interface. If the modular instrument itself does not have an independent development interface, each change needs to be compiled by an external host and downloaded into the module and then verified by the external host. This repeated download and verification caused great inconvenience to the debugging and maintenance of software. This paper introduces the design pattern to the development of module software, and designs proxy software for the software in the modular instrument. The proxy software has a general data interface, and as a solid data interaction and data processing core, agents for each measurement mode of data from the external application layer to the kernel hardware layer transmission, analysis, reading and writing. Taking the software design of LXI wide band down conversion module as an example, this paper starts with the requirement analysis of the wide band down conversion module, and gives the module software design architecture based on the proxy mode. The internal software of the wide band down conversion module is designed as proxy software, and the solution is given for the complex data transmission and the generality of the agent in the proxy software.

articleTitle: A Predictor-based ADRC for input delay systems subject to unknown disturbances
abstract: This paper presents a predictor-based active disturbance rejection control (PADRC) scheme for input delay systems. In the proposed control scheme, the extended state observer (ESO) is modified by delaying the control signal to compensate the time delay from the observation loop. Moreover, a predictor is designed in time domain to obtain estimated states for current time and cancel the effects of input delay on the closed-loop system, where the approximation of disturbances is considered for corrective prediction purposes. Furthermore, a PD controller is designed to compensate disturbances and control the system. Then, the stability of the closed-loop system is analyzed by the Lyapunov function method. Finally, the effectiveness of the PADRC is demonstrated by simulations.

articleTitle: Improving intersection capacity considering dilemma zone problem based on vehicle-to-infrastructure communications
abstract: Dilemma zone problem describes vehicles trapped in the road segment at the signalized intersection where drivers hard make accurate decisions for next movements. Such phenomenon can easily trigger traffic accidents or congestion, eventually, which likely decreases intersection capacity and also increases traffic pressure. How dose the issue evolve under Cooperative Vehicles Infrastructure Systems (CVIS)? In this paper, an optimization method is proposed to reduce the dilemma zone for enhancing the traffic capacity and safety of signalized intersections, which is based on the real-time traffic information by vehicles-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication. The problem is formulated as a Binary Mixed Integer Linear Program (BMILP) that can be solved by a standard branch-and-bound routine. A set of constraints is designed to ensure feasibility and safety of movements for connected vehicles. Numerical experiments show the capacity has a different degree of increase with the market penetration rate of connected vehicles increasing. Moreover, experimental results indicate the vehicle queue length at the signalized intersection reduces correspondingly.

articleTitle: Synergetic Control System for Multi-Robot Assembly Based on Multisource Heterrogeneous Information Fusion
abstract: To realize the synergetic control between two robots, a synergetic control system combining with multisource heterogeneous information fusion is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the same type information in multi-robot, such as displacement, velocities, et al., are merged by using predictive Kalman filtering method. By using Taylor series expansion equation, the iterative sensing information is modified, and the state covariance is updated. Secondly, according to the distribution of space, function, and time, the heterogeneous information fusion method is used to improve the flexibility and robustness of the multi-robot synergetic assembly system. The iterative least square estimation algorithm is adopted. Numerical simulation results are reported to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Cross-Network Clock Synchronization Scheme With Low Complexity for Industrial Internet of Things
abstract: In Industrial Internet of Things (IIOT), devices possess a tight timing relationship between each other so that precise clock synchronization is an important technology for networks to function properly. In this paper, we investigate the clock synchronization problem of IIOT in a heterogeneous industrial network which consists of two types of subnetworks: industrial wireless field network and wired backhaul network. Based on border gateway forwarding, a cross-network clock synchronization scheme with low complexity for IIOT is proposed. The industrial wireless field network and the wired backhaul network can get synchronized simply via software and without the requirement of hardware synchronization unit. Moreover, the mixed transmission of time synchronization data and network protocol data is supported. The cross-network synchronization scheme is designed in detail and implemented on an experimental platform. Test results show that the proposed method can meet the requirement of cross-network clock synchronization with low complexity and is convenient for unified management and Internet Protocol (IP) transmission of the networks.

articleTitle: Game Robot's Vision Based on Faster RCNN
abstract: The traditional object detection algorithms are slow in speed and low in accuracy. With the popularity of the deep learning algorithm, the object detection algorithm based on deep learning has been greatly improved compared with the traditional algorithm. So this paper is based on an improved Faster RCNN which is an excellent object detection algorithm framework to realize game robot's vision. In this algorithm, ResNet101 network extract features and position label mapping maps a single object with it's label. The information of moving chessman is obtained by tracking the change of frame from robot's camera to improve the accuracy and speed of the model recognition. This paper presents a more robust result than the traditional algorithm(canny detection or hough transform) by comparing the results of the single target and the multiple target under poor illumination condition. Our model was trained under small datasets and overcame traditional algorithm's drawback of illumination sensitivity. At the same time, some pruning optimization methods were used to boost detection speed.

articleTitle: Optimal Distributed Containment Control for Nonlinear Multi-Agent Graphical Games
abstract: A new optimal distributed control scheme is developed for the containment control problem of nonlinear multiagent graphical games. Adaptive dynamic programming method is applied to obtain the approximate optimal control policy of each follower which make the followers converge and keep moving within the convex hull of leaders and simultaneously achieve Nash equilibrium. The performance index of each follower is defined based on local neighborhood information. Moreover, an model-free integral reinforcement learning algorithm is proposed to update the value function and the control policy without knowing the system dynamics so as to avoid to solve the coupled Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman(HJB) equations, which is implemented by actor-critic structure and least-square method. Convergence analysis of the algorithm and asymptotical stability of the whole network are provided. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: State Error PCH Trajectory Tracking Control of an Unmanned Surface Vehicle
abstract: This study concerns the trajectory tracking control problem of an unmanned surface vehicle with external disturbances and parameter uncertainties. A novel robust trajectory tracking controller based on state error PCH principle and L2 gain disturbance attenuation approach is designed. Simulation results are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault diagnosis based on improved VMD and AR
abstract: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis plays a very important role in the troubleshooting of automobile chassis transmission. In this paper, an improved variational mode decomposition (VMD) method combined with AR spectrum analysis is proposed for fault diagnosis of rolling bearings. The bearing vibration signal is decomposed into several VIMF components by VMD method. It is suggested that the instantaneous mean value is used as the evaluation index to determine the number of VIMF components. The selected components are then analyzed by AR spectrum to produce the VMD-AR spectrum of the vibration signal and the cumulative energy of VMD-AR spectrum. The bearing fault is diagnosed by comparing and analyzing such two kinds of maps corresponding to the normal and faulty conditions. Practical experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed diagnostic method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Vehicle Control System Based on ROS
abstract: Intelligent vehicles, especially autonomous ones, have been studied in recent years. This paper proposes an intelligent vehicle control system solution. An upper-computer is employed to process sensor information detecting road conditions, while a STM32F103 microprocessor is used to implement vehicle motion control. The upper computer and the lower-MCU communicate with each other through the Modbus/RTU protocol. All the software in the designed is open source, scalable and at low cost. Experimental results show that the control system is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Design of Missile Attitude Controller Based on Nonlinear Dynamic Inverse Theory
abstract: The missile has the characteristics of multi-input and multi-output, strong nonlinearity and strong coupling in the course of flight, and also has the characteristics of complex aerodynamic effect and violent attitude change. Therefore, the traditional control method can't meet the requirements. Based on the nonlinear dynamic inverse theory, this paper divides the control system into fast loop and slow loop by using the idea of cascade structure control according to the characteristics of time scale difference in the dynamic response of state variables. The slow loop attitude controller and the fast loop attitude controller are designed by state feedback, which solves the problem of multi - input multi - output, strong nonlinearity and strong coupling of missile. Finally, the stability of the designed controller is verified by Lyapunov stability analysis. Based on the problem of large tracking error, a PI controller is designed on the basis of dynamic inverse controller to improve the accuracy of the controller. At the same time, the simulation results show that the controller has a certain perturbation of the aerodynamic parameters robustness.

articleTitle: Optimal Track Control For Reconfigurable Manipulator With Actuator Saturation Based on Adaptive Dynamic Programming
abstract: This paper investigates a novel optimal tracking controller for reconfigurable manipulators with actuator saturation based on a technology called adaptive(approximate) dynamic programming (ADP). The Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation corresponding to constrained control is formulated using a suitable nonquadratic functional. Setup a critic neural network, network is utilized to achieve the policy iteration (PI) algorithm, The HJB equation could be solved cause the policy iteration (PI) algorithm, and then we can earn the approximated optimal saturation controller. Finally, the simulation study is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed optimal tracking controller.

articleTitle: Fast Monocular Vision Based Vehicle Distance Measurement by License Plate Localization
abstract: In this paper, we propose a fast monocular vision based vehicle distance measurement method based on the vehicle and license plate detection. This method mainly comprises of three modules: vehicle detection, license plate localization and distance measurement. Firstly, the vehicle detection module relies on the Faster-RCNN algorithm, with different scale and aspect ratios for the region proposal network (RPN) by the analysis of KITTI datasets. The experimental results on the KITTI dataset show that the modified Faster-RCNN method can improve the average precision (AP) and perform even better than feature pyramid network (FPN). Secondly, we localize the license plate from the detected vehicle with basic image segmentation strategies, which can accurately segment out the license plate. Finally, Due to the fixed size of the general license plate, we can make a measurement for the distance between the frontal vehicle based on the camera interior parameters and geometrical reasoning. Experiments on our unmanned vehicle platform show that the proposed method can calculate the distance accurately within the safe distance of 30 meters.

articleTitle: Dynamic Prediction of NOx Emissions Based on Factor Analysis and NARX Neural Network
abstract: NOx emissions of thermal power plants are closely related to the environment. It is very important to research on the prediction of NOx emissions. However, most of the current models are static and did not take into account the impact of the previous data. Boiler combustion is a process with large delay, and NOx generation also goes through a certain process, so we cannot just focus on the data at the current moment. In this paper, the dynamic prediction model of NOx emissions combining factor analysis and NARX dynamic neural network is proposed. The common factors that play the important roles in NOx formation are extracted based on the factor analysis method. It can eliminate the collinearity of the original data and reduce the complexity of modeling. The factor score matrix of common factors is used as the input of the NARX neural network, and a dynamic model is established, taking full account of the influence of various operating parameters and output parameters on the NOx emission at the previous moment. The simulation results show the effective and feasible of the model in NOx emissions prediction.

articleTitle: An Application of Adaptive-Capacitor-Converter in Improving the Stability of the Cascade System in DC-Microgrid
abstract: A problem about the stability of the cascade system exists in distributed power system because of the impedance characteristic curve intersection between the source converter and the load converter. In this paper, an Adaptive-Capacitor-Converter(ACC) is proposed to adjust the impedance curves with the aim of preventing intersection, which can assist the unstable cascade system to satisfy the impedance rule to make the system stable. This proposed application has these following advantages: the circuit is simple, a method of nonelectrolytic capacitor is achieved. The topology of this converter, the operation modes analysis and the control strategy are proposed. Finally the simulation result is listed to verify the correctness of the analysis and the feasibility of ACC.

articleTitle: Hybrid PI and Backstepping Controller Design of The LC-Type Three-phase Inverter
abstract: In LC-Type three-phase inverter systems, the sole linear or nonlinear control is difficult to consider the controller design and characteristics simultaneously. Therefore, a hybrid controller based on proportion integration(PI) and backstepping approach is proposed for the LC-Type three-phase inverter. By analyzing the different control requirements of the active and reactive power control loop in steady and transient states, the active power loop is recommended to adopt the backstepping control based on the reverse steps to complete the controller design and introduce the Lyapunov stability theory to ensure the large signal stability. The PI control is utilized in the reactive power control loop to minimize the complexity of design controller. Finally, the experimental results further verify the superiority of the designed controller over the conventional PI controller.

articleTitle: Finite Element Calculation of Normal Electromagnetic Force at Feature Key-points of Permanent-magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: Under the action of too large electromagnetic force, the structure fault of permanent magnet synchronous motor may occur. In this study, a mathematical model of permanent magnet synchronous motor which combines a two-dimensional magnetic field-path coupled finite element method with Maxwell's stress method was proposed first. Then, the harmonic decomposition graph and distribution of harmonic content of normal magnetic flux density were obtained by analyzing the magnetic flux density change characteristics at the key points. Finally, the variations of the normal electromagnetic force at feature key points were calculated. The calculation results show that the change rule of magnetic flux density is related to the feature key-point; the 13 times harmonic content at feature key-point should be attached with high attention, which provides theoretical support for studying vibration characteristics of motor structure.

articleTitle: Consensus Disturbance Rejection with Delay and Parameter Adaptive Estimation
abstract: This paper deals with the consensus disturbance rejection problem for systems subject to delay and unknown parameter. Three main problems are considered. The first problem is how to deal with input delay. Due to the communication condition, the delays could be large or small, so it is difficult to use the robust technique to deal with. The second problem is the disturbance rejection. The disturbance under consideration are unknown constant disturbances or sinusoidal functions with unknown amplitudes and phases. Third, we consider the unknown graph algebraic connectivity case. This assumption is useful since fully distributed controller can only be designed without this global information. Predictor feedback method and predictor observer design method are both used to deal with the delay. Disturbance observer-based control (DOBC) strategy is used to estimate the disturbance and adaptive technique is applied to estimate the graph algebraic connectivity. Finally, consensus disturbance rejection controllers are designed for all the agents and the consensus can be achieved with certain condition derived from the Lyapunov analysis.

articleTitle: Statistical Distribution Analysis and Prediction of Time Between Failures in On-board Train Control Equipment
abstract: On-board train control equipment is the core equipment to ensure the safety and smooth operation of the train, the prognostics and health management for on-board equipment(OBE) has great significance. In this paper, aiming at the uncertainty of OBE failure and under the circumstances of less failure samples, puts forward that regard the whole OBE as a black box, the analysis and prediction of time between failures is conducted. Firstly, through the statistical analysis of the train operation fault log files, the sample series of time between failures(TBF) is obtained. The statistical distribution analysis is performed for the sample series, and the Weibull distribution model is established and tested, it shows that it has certain rules and can be predicted. Finally, TBF is used for short time prediction based on grey support vector machine, the accuracy of general and serious faults are 86.87% and 90.04<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> respectively by example verification, it shows that this method has good predictive effect, the prediction results have certain guiding significance for CBM.

articleTitle: A Self-adaption Kalman Federated Applying on Multisensor Positioninging System
abstract: Federated Kalman Filter is the more suitable filter for a multisensor system than a general Kalman Filter. For the Federated Kalman Filter, the information distribution is one of the key factors. The new self-adaption federated Kalman Filter is proposed to find a self-adaption distribution factor. The filter bases on a gyroscope, accelerometer as well as the positioning and navigation system(GPS). It aims to be used in the vehicle navigation system. The filter in this paper applying a simulated annealing (SA) algorithm as a correction for the distribution factor at lower time cost. The theoretical analysis and simulation results all show a stable filtering results.

articleTitle: An Overview of Short-term Load Forecasting Based on Characteristic Enterprises
abstract: Load forecasting is the basic work of power planning, consumption, dispatching, etc. This paper provides an overview of short-term load forecasting based on characteristic enterprises. Based on the research status of the field, the background and significance of short-term load forecasting are discussed. This paper summarizes the characteristics and prediction methods of the enterprise with characteristic electricity consumption. This paper also gives a brief overview of the application of deep learning and data mining in short-term load forecasting. The problems existing in short-term load forecasting and the subsequent research directions are put forward.

articleTitle: Modified Firefly Algorithm for Handling Optimal Power Flow Control with Operational Constraints
abstract: This study describes firefly algorithm (FA) to solve optimal power flow (OPF) control with satisfying various operational constraints. Due to firefly algorithm is easy to convergence prematurely and has the inferior solving skills, thus, modified firefly algorithm (MFA) is formed by combining the dimensional-based approach with lévy flight, which is incorporated in original FA. The proposed MFA approach is implemented on IEEE30- bus system for solving optimal power flow control. Besides, the results obtained by the MFA algorithm are comparable with those of FA and PSO. The numerical results demonstrate the capabilities of the MFA algorithm to generate true and well-distributed solutions of the OPF control. The simulation results also show that the MFA produces better quality of the solutions than other algorithms. This learning can be more beneficial to the further research of optimal power flow control.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Inverter Monitoring System Based on Cloud Service
abstract: Light energy is widely used in many fields due to its abundant resources and low cost of use. Photovoltaic power generation is an important part of China's power sources, in order to better develop light energy and use light energy, it is necessary to monitor its power generation system. Aiming at the current remote monitoring mode of photovoltaic power generation in China, a monitoring system of photovoltaic inverter based on cloud service is designed. The bottom layer of the system uses STM32 for centralized processing of information, and the networking chip uses the W5500 hardware protocol stack chip. After experiment, the system can realize real-time remote monitoring of the operating data of the PV inverter.

articleTitle: Design of wireless remote data acquisition system based on three layer network Wireless
abstract: This paper designs and implements a remote wireless data acquisition system based on the three tier network structure. The system integrates data acquisition technology, embedded system, wireless network, database technology and Internet, uses a custom network protocol and uses single chip as the core of data acquisition. Through 2.4G wireless transmission, application of database and Internet technology, it realizes the confirmation license based on any terminal in the interconnected network. Any sensor information of the data acquisition node can be accessed.

articleTitle: Structural Analysis for Cyber Attack Detection and Isolation Problem in Smart Grid
abstract: In this paper, the structural detectability analysis for the attack detection and isolation (ADI) problem by considering the structural vulnerability in smart grid is studied. Based on a classical grid model, the ADI problem is presented. Then, this paper adopts the framework of structural control theory to solve this problem when the grid system under consideration is structured, that is, the entries of grid system matrices are either fixed zeros or free parameters. Based on the properties of structural grid system, a necessary and sufficient graph theoretic condition is shown to address the ADI problem by adding new sensors. Finally, an illustrative example is given to solve the ADI problem on the IEEE 6-bus grid system.

articleTitle: Study on optimization of soot blowing based on monitoring model of coal-fired power station soot accumulation
abstract: In view of the present unreasonable situation about the blowing way of boiler heating surface, an optimized model of soot blowing was established to improve the economic benefit of the unit, after weighing the improvement of boiler efficiency and steam loss caused by ash blowing and ensuring the safe operation of the unit. The measured data of thermal power plant DCS system and the basic thermodynamic calculation data was adopted, and the contamination rate of heating surface was calculated in real time. The fitted curve was taken by taking the expected data from multiple data sets at the same measuring point from the statistical point of view, combining the optimization model of the heating surface to solve the optimal soot blowing cycle in the boiler economizer of 300 MW coal-fired power plant, which was taken as the research object.

articleTitle: Multi Point Suspension Cooperative Modeling and Control of Low Speed Maglev Vehicle
abstract: The maglev vehicle is becoming a new type of urban transport because of its short turning radius, comfortable and environmental characteristics. In this paper, the multi-point suspension system of maglev train is studied, and the correlative cooperative control law is proposed to solve the problem that the multi-coils cannot be effectively decoupled. Firstly, a current feedback model of single coil maglev system is established. On this basis, the relative errors between multi-coils are determined, and the cross-coupling control strategy is adopted to coordinate the coil output effectively. Finally, the validity of the control law is verified based on the platform of MATLAB/Simulink. It provides an effective way to solve the output asynchronism of multi-point suspension system without complete decoupling.

articleTitle: An Improved Wireless Sensor Network for Natural Gas Monitoring
abstract: Natural gas has become an important resource for people's living and industrial production. The safety of natural gas transportation is of great importance. In view of the characteristics that natural gas is transported by pressurized pipelines. This paper proposes a wireless sensor network(WSN) of natural gas monitoring. The network consists of two layers. The first layer clusters the sensor nodes according to the improved LEACH cluster head selection strategy. It also selects the cluster head to aggregate data within a cluster. The second layer of the network distributes the clusters on either side of the satellite nodes. The arrangement of clusters on each side is energy-average. Therefore, the energy consumption of each cluster head node is averaged. The life cycle and stability of the network will extend. In this paper, MATLAB is used to compare the average energy arrangement and uniform arrangement. The result shows that the average energy arrangement has a significant improvement in network lifetime.

articleTitle: Research on IETM-based Equipment Electronic Training
abstract: The more modernized the weaponry, the higher training and support requirements for personnel. Reducing training expenses, shortening training time, and improving training quality are important issues faced by our army's equipment training. Based on traditional physical training and classroom teaching, introducing Interactive Electronic Training (IETM) technology is of great significance for improving training quality and shortening training time. IETM has significant advantages in data management, information organization, knowledge expression, and strong interactivity, and has been applied and promoted in our military equipment. Based on the analysis of equipment interactive training requirements, this paper proposes an IETM-based electronic training scheme. The scheme reuses the data module information of existing IETM, arranges them according to the training organization model, publishes interactive electronic training courseware that conforms to the SCORM/S6000T standard, and conducts electronic training for simulation in the electronic training system.

articleTitle: Optimization of control parameters in microdefect Czochralski monocrystalline silicon growth
abstract: To improve crystal microdefect control in silicon single crystal growth, this paper proposes a new method, which can not only obtain optimal process parameter track via numerical simulation analysis and optimization, but also realize simultaneous control of the crystal diameter and micro-defect. Meanwhile, CGSim software numerical is used to simulate influence of crystal height and pulling rate changes on the shape of solid liquid interface and the V/G value during the growth process of φ300mm silicon single crystal in the cusp magnetic field. Then, numerical simulation data analysis is employed to obtain the V/G value of solid liquid interface at the isometric stage as well as the optimal pulling rate track and heater power track in accordance with requirements of crystal growth. This can provide reference for high-quality silicon single crystal growth control.

articleTitle: Research on Surface Defects Detection of Stainless Steel Spoon Based on Machine Vision
abstract: Using the knowledge of digital image processing and the knowledge of optical imaging, the problem of difficult to obtain detailed images of high-gloss surfaces is solved. A stainless steel surface defect detection method based on image processing technology is proposed. The defect image is filtered by the mean value and the gray level is changed. An automatic threshold segmentation method is proposed. Finally, the defect type is discriminated by feature extraction. Experiments show that the method is simple, rapid, and accurate. It can effectively identify flaws and scratches on the surface of stainless steel spoons.

articleTitle: Prediction of Direct Normal Irradiance using a Novel Multi-model Algorithm
abstract: The prediction of solar radiation is a hot issue in the field of solar energy and time series data analysis. Due to the rapidly development of photovoltaic (PV), most related works just focus on the Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI), while the Direct Normal Irradiance (DNI) is more important for another new solar energy technology: solar thermal. The DNI is related to GHI, however, the they are not corresponding one by one. Furthermore, the change rules of DNI is very various in different meteorological conditions. For example, in the cloudy day the DNI is more likely to change sharply than the clear day. Thus, a method to deal with these different weather conditions is needed. This paper proposes a multi-model algorithm to matching this new requirement, by building a complex network, we describe the relationship between the different sample, and then using a community detection method based on modularity optimization, we cluster the samples into different classes. Finally, we deal with these classes by different extreme learning machine models. The experimental result based on the real data proven this multi-model algorithm is useful.

articleTitle: Research on Equipment Electronic Training System
abstract: The extensive use of high-tech weapon equipment has a major impact on equipment training and technical support. New equipment is expensive, diverse, and scarce. It is becoming more and more difficult to carry out maintenance training on actual equipment. Equipment electronic training has become an important alternative to train on actual equipment. Based on the analysis of equipment interactive training requirements, this paper proposes a design scheme for equipment electronic training system. The scheme provides a runtime environment for interactive equipment electronic training courseware, and implements management of training outline, training plan, training courseware, examination questions and so on. It uses human-computer interaction to conduct teaching, learning, self-training, training assessment, and effect evaluation. It supports equipment training of normal use, fault maintenance, and safety. It can replace training on actual equipment, improve training quality, and shorten training time.

articleTitle: ORB-Based Fast Anti-Viewing Image Feature Matching Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the original ORB algorithm is difficult to solve the effective matching problem under large angle of view transformation. This paper proposes an image feature matching algorithm based on ORB to resist the change of view according to the principle of ASIFT. The basic idea of the algorithm is as follows, Firstly, the longitude angle and latitude angle caused by the rotation of the camera are simulated, and the simulated image sequence set which is deformed by the change of the optical axis direction of the camera is accurately simulated. Then the feature points are extracted and mapped them into the original image by combining the FAST feature point detection method with the BRISK feature descriptors. Finally, the Brute-Force Matcher and the Random Sampling Consistency (RANSAC) method were used for feature matching and optimization. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can solve the problem that the image features cannot be matched under the large change of viewing angle (greater than 60°), and it has a significant improvement in real-time performance compared with ASIFT.

articleTitle: Robust Predictive Control for Boiler-Turbine Coordinated Control System
abstract: Boiler-turbine unit is a multi-input multi-output (MIMO) nonlinear system with large time-delay and a lot of disturbances, so that conventional boiler-turbine coordinated control system (CCS) cannot achieve satisfactory performance. In this paper, we consider an output-feedback robust predictive control strategy for boiler-turbine unit affected by immeasurable bounded disturbances. This control strategy combining moving horizon estimation with robust model predictive control is finally formulated as a min-max optimization problem solved by a primal-dual interior-point method. At each sampling time, the optimization criterion is maximized over worst-case estimates of initial state and disturbance sequence and minimized over optimal control sequence. In this way, the controller can effectively reject constrained disturbances. Simulation results verify that this control strategy could provide significant robustness under common disturbances such as slow time-variation of coal low heat value and dead zone characteristics of throttle valve position.

articleTitle: Distributed Finite-time Consensus Tracking for Second-Order Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: This paper considers the consensus tracking control problem in a finite-time for second-order leader-follower multi-agent systems. Firstly, a finite-time distributed control protocol with time-varying gain is given. In this approach, agents can be impelled to consensus tracking at a preset time with a static leader rely on adjacent agents' states. Then, the fact that all the followers' states can reach the agreement to the leader at a preset time is proved theoretically, if the topology of network is a connected undirected graph. In the end, some experimental results prove the validity of the previous proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Compound Control for Hypersonic Vehicles Based on Dynamic Compensation
abstract: It is widely recognized that the dynamic models of Hypersonic Vehicles (HV) exist strong coupled and highly nonlinear. In this paper, a compound control method combines active disturbance rejection (ADRC) with slide mode control (SMC) is proposed by analyzing the longitudinal model of HV. This paper designs the ADRC controller for the velocity control and SMC controller for the height control separately. The extended state observers (ESO) are used to estimate the nonlinear component in the velocity loop and height loop. The simulation results show that the control method developed has good performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Iterative Learning Control for Trajectory Tracking of Uncertain Robotic Systems
abstract: To track the trajectory of a robotic system in presence of random disturbances and modeling uncertainties, a robust adaptive iterative learning control algorithm that consists of an easy-to-design PD controller, a unique learning feedforward controller and a robust term is proposed in this paper. This new hybrid control algorithm is characterized by an easy-to design PD controller to guarantee the stability of the system status; a feedforward learning controller to calculate the desired actuator torque at each iterative step by a learning rule, and a robust control term to ensure the robustness of the system under external random disturbances. The convergence of the system is proved based on the Lyapunov stability theory. It is demonstrated by simulation results that proposed algorithm not only improves the better tracking performance, but also has obvious advantages over other control methods in terms of accelerating convergence speed.

Author Keywords: Iterative learning control. Robotic system. Trajectory tracking. Adaptive control. Robust control

articleTitle: Application of ZigBee Location Fingerprint Method in Positioning of Railway Tunnel Staff
abstract: In order to enable managers to grasp the precise location of personnel in the tunnel in time, so as to achieve reasonable deployment and efficient command for employees, and improve management and emergency command capabilities, a ZigBee location fingerprint positioning method for railway tunnel staff is proposed. Considering the low efficiency of the traditional location fingerprint positioning, firstly, the improved K-means algorithm is used to cluster the location fingerprint database, in order to reduce the number of matches in the online phase and reference nodes, and then it is carried on online positioning. The results show that the ZigBee location fingerprint method based on the improved K-means algorithm not only shortens the positioning time, but also effectively improves the positioning accuracy, and it can satisfy the position service requirements of the staff in the tunnel.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fuzzy Sliding-Mode Control for Piston Stop Position of the GDI Engine
abstract: The crucial problem of the instantaneous reverse starting technique is the piston stop-position control, it is very difficult to control the piston stop position. In this paper, the piston stop position control is converted to the electric throttle control technique. A novel composite controller for complex nonlinear electronic throttle of GDI engine is designed, the feedforward controller is used to compensate the spring torque and friction torque, the feedback controller is adaptive fuzzy sliding-mode controller which is based on fuzzy control and sliding-mode control. This controller can not only retains the rapidity and robustness of sliding mode control, but also reduces the buffeting. The simulation results show that the composite controller can enable the throttle opening to track the input quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Controllability Analysis of a Class of Affine Nonlinear System
abstract: This paper studies the controllability of a class of affine nonlinear systems in the discrete-time case without time-delay. A series of necessary and sufficient conditions for the global state controllability and global output controllability are separately presented and proved under some fundamental assumptions.

articleTitle: Multiple Time-Scale Optimization Scheduling for Microgrids
abstract: In order to achieve the minimum operational cost of the microgrid and maximum environmental satisfaction, a multiple time-scale optimization scheduling for a grid-connected microgrid is presented, including day-ahead scheduling stage and daily scheduling stage. In this paper, the research on microgrid mainly including photovoltaics (PV), wind turbine (WT), energy storages, loads and tie line power. In the day-ahead scheduling stage takes into account the minimum operational cost as the objective function. In the daily scheduling stage, achieve the minimizing of the adjustment of the day-ahead scheduling and giving priority to the use of renewable energy. The improved algorithm of PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) is used to solve the MINLP(Mixed Integer Nonlinear Programming) problems. In order to ensure that the microgrid system obtains the global optimal solution, the new migration strategy was proposed and displace the velocity update strategy. Simulation results shown that the proposed multiple time-scale optimization scheduling approach shown that minimum operational cost and maximize the use of renewable energies, making the microgrid operation more economical, cleaner and more efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Saturation of PMSM System Regulator for Electric Vehicle
abstract: The saturation phenomenon often happens to the regulator in the start-up procedure of electric vehicles. And the dynamic and static performance of the motor will be worse while this phenomenon lasts longer. In this paper, firstly we will analyze the causes of this phenomenon, and then propose an effective method to solve the regulator saturation. Based on traditional double-loop vector control, this method increased the voltage cut-off negative feedback and combined the state feedback linearization to realize the dynamic decoupling between currents and solve the current regulator saturation problem which happens during start-up procedure. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method were verified by simulation experiments, and the comprehensive performance of the motor, including speed range, speed tracking performance and dynamic response, was improved.

articleTitle: Design and Control of a Two-wheeled Self-balancing Robot made in 3D Printing
abstract: 3D printing can help designers finish design with low cost and short cycle. Using the 3D printing technology to manufacture a two-wheeled self-balancing robot can quickly realize the experimental platform construction and structure verification. In the aspect of control, traditional PID has the problem of difficulty in adjusting parameters, and it has no self-adaptive characteristics for flexible 3D printing structure design. In this paper, fuzzy control is used to adjust the PID parameters, and the control of the two-wheeled self-balancing robot system is realized through fuzzy PID. Comprehensive movement experimental results show that the control method can make the system more rapid and stable.

articleTitle: PID Optimization of Motion Servo Control System Based on Improved Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm
abstract: As one of the most common controllers, PID controller has the characteristics of simple principle and excellent control effect, and is widely used in the field of industrial control. The three parameters of the PID controller: the ratio of proportional (K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P</sub>), integral (K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>), and differential (K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>) determine the performance of the controller. In order to solve this problem, an improved algorithm based on artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA) is proposed for the optimization of PID of motion servo control system. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has a good optimization effect on the PID of the motion servo control system.

articleTitle: Multi-agent based multi-motor coupled system tension control
abstract: In order to solve the contradiction between rapid response and high precision in tension control of multi-motor coupled system, a multi-agent based sliding mode control algorithm is proposed. This method continuously adjusts the state control vector of its own motor and adjacent motor, bring the system to the desired value quickly. In addition, the control algorithm can effectively reduce the periodic disturbance of the reel caused by the unevenness of the airbag material. Finally, the proposed control algorithm is simulated and analyzed. The results show that the control strategy can effectively control the tension and speed of the system, accelerate the system's response speed, and improve the system's robustness.

articleTitle: A Feature Extraction Strategy of Fire Hole Video Based on VGG16 and Migration Learning
abstract: The superheat degree (SD) is the comprehensive performance of cell condition. In the aluminum electrolysis process, identifying the state of SD plays an important role in improving the current efficiency. The existing methods are usually based on the artificial experience combining with video of the fire hole video, which including artificially extracting features and then classifying them via machine learning algorithms. However, because of dwindling and frequent change of experiential technicians, some features being difficult to extract manually. Therefore, the existing methods do encounter the bottleneck to ensure the classification accuracy of SD states. In this paper, a strategy that extracting video features of fire holes based on convolutional neural network is proposed. The proposed strategy effectively integrates VGG16 and migration leaning to selected useful features. Simulation results validate that the proposed method is able to dig out the deeper features and make a more accurate judgment on the state of SD.

articleTitle: Image Inpainting with LS-SVM Based on Gradient Information
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy, a method for image inpainting with least squares support vector machine based on gradient information is proposed in this paper. The gradient information is introduced as the training data, and the additive high order kernel function is designed for full consideration of the correlation in the image. The pixel gray intensities of the damaged region are estimated according to the trained model. The experimental results show that the proposed model improves the inpaining effect significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Online Tuning Technology of Speed Controller of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: For the problem of parameter self-tuning for speed controller in the vector control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), an online self-tuning method based on gradient search is proposed to tune the proportional and integral coefficients. The method uses the integral of the speed error square as a cost function. It calculates the gradient of cost function at each sample interval, and updates speed controller parameters according to gradient descent method. The proposed method does not need to identify the motor parameters at each iteration and it utilizes low computational resources. Because of short computation time and small memory space, the proposed method is easy to be implemented in practice. This paper simulates the performances of the speed controller implementing the proposed method under different conditions, and it compares the performances with traditional PID controller. The simulation results show that the proposed method adapts to the load change effectively and the system is stable.

articleTitle: A High-Precision Vision-Based Mobile Robot Slope Detection Method in Unknown Environment
abstract: Aiming at satisfying the demand of slope perception accuracy for mobile robots in the unknown environment, a high-precision vision-based mobile robot slope detection method in unknown environment is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the RGB images of slopesin the unknown environment arecaptured by the Kinect sensor installed on the mobile robot, and edge sharpening is performed on the images of slopes. Then, the coordinates of the slope edge pixel in the image coordinate system are transformed into the camera coordinate system to obtain the real length of the slope. Finally, the single image depth estimation method based on convolution neural network (CNN) is used to estimate the depth of theslope image toobtain the projection length of the slope only using a single slope image, and the slope angle is obtained by the inverse cosine function. The experimental results show that the slope detection method proposed in this paper has higher detection accuracy and can satisfy the demand of slope sensing accuracy of mobile robot in unknown environment.

articleTitle: Forest Fire Detection with Color Features and Wavelet Analysis Based on Aerial Imagery
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), equipped with vision-based systems, can be used for forest fire monitoring and detection due to their low cost, fast response capability, and high safety. This paper proposes a novel approach to forest fire detection, which uses the color characteristics of the images taken by the UAVs and uses wavelet analysis to further process. Firstly, according to the color characteristics of forest flame and smoke, a low computational cost algorithm is adopted to extract pixels from its related regions. In order to correct the inaccuracy of color feature extraction, a two-dimensional discrete wavelet transform (nWT) is implemented to distinguish flame and the smoke area from other high-frequency noise signals. Multiple sets of experiments have proved that the algorithm proposed can effectively detect the forest flame and smoke part of the image. The good performance is anticipated to significantly improve the accuracy of forest fire detection on the basis of less computational cost and can perform real-time detection on the UAVs platform.

articleTitle: Distributed Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Linear Multi-Agent Systems Over Directed Graph
abstract: In this paper, the consensus problem of multiagent systems (MAS) with unknown disturbances has been addressed, by a novel feedforward control protocol. A distributed observer-based protocol, which extendes active disturbance rejection control(ADRC) to MAS under directed graph, has been proposed. Firstly, the local states and disturbances are estimated simultaneously by extended state observers. Secondly, states and disturbances based on observers have been applied to control protocol, which avoids chatting phenomenon and lagged effects caused by existing discontinuous control protocals, and the assumption about disturbances is relaxed. Thirdly, the case that the derivative of disturbance is bounded is discussed. Finally, simulations validate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control protocal.

articleTitle: Feedback Feed-Forward Control of Piezoelectric Positioning Stages and Experimental Evaluation
abstract: This study addresses the problem of precise tracking control for a piezoelectric positioning stage (PZT). In order to make full use of the advantages of feedback and feed-forward control, in this paper, the feedback and feed-forward iterative learning control with inverse hysteresis compensation (FFILCWIH) has been proposed to control of the PZT. First, the architecture of the PZT platform is introduced, then, the model of PZT is identified with experimental data, furthermore, five control algorithms are performed on the PZT experimental platform. The results show that the FFILCWIH method is especially suitable for tracking the triangular waveform signal.

articleTitle: Torque Ripple Minimization in Brushless DC Motor with Optimal Current Vector Control Technique
abstract: Brushless DC Motor (BLDCM) inevitably suffers from commutation torque ripple due to stator inductance and the finite dc-link voltage, which may degrade the torque performance. This paper analyzes the commutation torque ripple under traditional two phase on operation in vector coordinate system. Based on the analysis, this paper presents a novel drive method of BLDCM with vector control to minimize commutation torque ripple. In this method, the optimal current vector can be obtained by calculating constraint equation of both torque ripple minimization and maximum torque per ampere characteristic (MTPA), which avoids control method switch between normal conduction period and commutation period and improves system reliability. Simulation and experimental results for a 3.7kW BLDCM are presented to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Control of Differential Drive Mobile Robot Based on Improved Kinematics Controller Algorithm
abstract: An important issue in wheeled mobile robot motion control is that most of robot controllers are designed relying solely on the kinematics of robots. However, when highspeed motion or heavyduty transportation are required for mobile robots, the description of the robot kinematics model is not comprehensive, and it is necessary to consider the robot dynamics model. Based on the work of reference [16], this paper makes an improvement on the kinematic controller by replacing the hyperbolic tangent function tanh(x) by the reference function sin(arctan(x)). This function ensures that the kinematic controller can improve the tracking accuracy of the robot and the distance error will be significantly reduced. Simultaneous position tracking, line speed and angular velocity tracking on the X and Y axes are achieved. Finally, the results of simulation experiments in three cases show that the tracking precision in this paper is obviously superior to the reference [16], and it has stronger robustness and better anti-jamming performance.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Control for Networked Control Systems Under Replay Attacks
abstract: With wide application of networked control systems(N CSs), NCSs security have encountered severe challenges. In this paper, we propose a robust event-triggered controller design method under replay attacks, and the control signal on the plant is updated only when the event-triggering condition is satisfied. We develop a general random replay attack model rather than predetermined specific patterns for the occurrences of replay attacks, which allows to obtain random states to replay. We show that the proposed event-triggered control (ETC) scheme, if well designed, can tolerate some consecutive replay attacks, without affecting the corresponding closed-loop system stability and performance. A numerical examples is finally given to illustrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Multi-task Assignment of Logistics Distribution based on Modified Ant Colony Optimization
abstract: In the process of logistics task allocation, the number of logistics truck is limited. How to make use of the limited delivery truck to deliver all the goods in the region to the destination quickly and reduce the transportation cost as far as possible is one of the objectives of logistics enterprise development. This paper presents a modified ant colony optimization for this problem. The algorithm combines ant colony optimization and k-opt algorithm to solve the instability of the optimization result of ant colony optimization. Through combinatorial optimization algorithm, the logistics task is rationalized and distributed scientifically, so as to improve the efficiency of truck use, thus improving the core competitiveness of logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Face Recognition System Based on Convolution Neural Network
abstract: This paper presents a FPGA implementation of face recognition system based on convolution neural network. The hardware architectures for convolution layers, pooling layers, full-connected layer and softmax layer are designed. In each convolution layer, the parallelisms among convolution kernels and among feature maps are explored, and the convolution operations are carried out in parallel. The pooling operations for different feature maps are also computed in parallel. The Verilog HDL modules for the architectures are designed, simulated and synthesized to FPGA. The result shows that the architectures designed in this paper are correct and effective.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Intelligent Vehicle Based on Optimized A* Algorithm
abstract: Based on the traditional A* algorithm, this paper focuses on the shortcomings and disadvantage of the A* algorithm in process of the path search. Through the optimization of the ant colony algorithm, the search path of the improved A* algorithm is shorter, less time-consuming, smaller total turning angle, and the path is smoother. And then the comparison simulation is used to verify its correctness. Taking the intelligent vehicle as a hardware platform, sensors such as lidar and IMU carried are used to determine the pose of their own space and to acquire information on obstacles in the surrounding environment and establish an environmental map. Conduct indoor navigation experiments in real environment on the built hardware platform to verify its feasibility in practical application. The final experimental results show that in the indoor environment with obstacles, the car can accurately plan an optimal path, and can successfully avoid the obstacles and reach the target point, and the navigation is successful. This shows that the improved A* algorithm is not only theoretically effective, but also practically applicable

articleTitle: Neural Signature and Classification of Emergency Braking Intention Based on Effective Connectivity
abstract: In this paper, to further understand the neural mechanism of emergency braking and find new features for emergency braking intention detection, we explore the brain neural correlates of emergency braking intentions by using effective connectivity analysis, which is based on directed transfer function (DTF). Offline analysis shows there exists changes in connectivity between electrodes before and after the onset of emergency. Furthermore, a novel method of emergency braking intention classification was proposed based on connectivity features. Area under curve (AUC) is calculated to evaluate the classification performance of connectivity features. Three preprocessing method were compared. The average AUC of the best method can reach 0.8632, which shows a good classification. This research is of great value for the future development of brain-controlled vehicles.

articleTitle: Multi-mode and distributed model predictive control for whole day train regulation
abstract: To further improve the operation efficiency of metro trains, a multi-mode and distributed model predictive control (DMPC) algorithm is proposed for whole day train regulation of metro transportation in presence of time-varying passenger arrival rate and disturbances. Firstly, a multi-mode switching train operation model in a metro line is built with a switched linear function describing dynamic passenger demand. Secondly, a DMPC-based strategy for train regulation is proposed to ensure the punctuality and security of whole day train operation.
